flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: A crack or breach, a gap or fissure; a defect of continuity or cohesion.
flashcards.example: That vase has a flaw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 裂缝或缺口、间隙或裂缝；连续性或内聚力的缺陷。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那个花瓶有一个缺陷。

flashcards.definition: Someone who inherits, or is designated to inherit, the property of another.
flashcards.example: This is the word Heir.
flashcards.definitionZh: 继承或指定继承他人财产的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是继承人这个词。

flashcards.definition: An escalator clause.
flashcards.example: They agreed to a cost-of-living escalator.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自动扶梯条款。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们同意生活费用自动扶梯。

flashcards.definition: Any device or machine, especially one whose name cannot be recalled. Often either clever or complicated.
flashcards.example: He bought a neat new gadget for shredding potatoes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何设备或机器，尤其是名字记不起的设备或机器。通常要么聪明，要么复杂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他买了一个漂亮的新玩意儿，用来切土豆丝。

flashcards.definition: A girl or an unmarried young woman; maiden.
flashcards.example: This is the word Maid.
flashcards.definitionZh: 女孩或未婚的年轻女子；少女。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是女仆这个词。

flashcards.definition: A natural or innate talent or aptitude.
flashcards.example: to have a flair for art
flashcards.definitionZh: 自然或与生俱来的才能或能力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有艺术天赋

flashcards.definition: A room containing a number of beds (and often some other furniture and/or utilities) for sleeping, often applied to student and backpacker accommodation of this kind.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dormitory.
flashcards.definitionZh: 包含许多床（通常还有一些其他家具和/或公用设施）供睡眠的房间，通常适用于此类学生和背包客住宿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是宿舍这个词。

flashcards.definition: A customer, a buyer or receiver of goods or services.
flashcards.example: This is the word Client.
flashcards.definitionZh: 顾客、商品或服务的购买者或接收者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“客户”一词。

flashcards.definition: A school or place of training in which some special art is taught.
flashcards.example: the military academy at West Point; a riding academy; the Academy of Music.; a music academy; a language academy
flashcards.definitionZh: 教授某些特殊艺术的学校或培训场所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 西点军校；马术学院；音乐学院。音乐学院；语言学院

flashcards.definition: One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceived, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular:
flashcards.example: the youngest victims of the brutal war
flashcards.definitionZh: 受到某人或某事，尤其是另一个人或事件、力量或状况的伤害（被杀、受伤、受到压迫、欺骗或其他不利影响）；尤其：
flashcards.exampleZh: 残酷战争中最年轻的受害者

flashcards.definition: A legal sentence.
flashcards.example: The penalty for his crime was to do hard labor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 法律判决。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对他的罪行的惩罚是做苦役。

flashcards.definition: Any activity, such as play, that amuses, diverts or stimulates.
flashcards.example: This is the word Recreation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何娱乐、娱乐或刺激的活动，例如玩耍。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“休闲”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A long seat with or without a back, found for example in parks and schools.
flashcards.example: They sat on a park bench and tossed bread crumbs to the ducks and pigeons.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有靠背或无靠背的长座椅，例如在公园和学校中常见。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们坐在公园的长椅上，向鸭子和鸽子扔面包屑。

flashcards.definition: A serviette; a (usually rectangular) piece of cloth or paper used at the table for wiping the mouth and hands for cleanliness while eating.
flashcards.example: This is the word Napkin.
flashcards.definitionZh: 餐巾；餐桌上使用的一块（通常是矩形的）布或纸，用于在吃饭时擦拭嘴和手以保持清洁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是餐巾这个词。

flashcards.definition: A residential area located on the outskirts of a city or large town that usually includes businesses that cater to its residents; such as schools, grocery stores, shopping centers, restaurants, convenience stores, etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word Suburb.
flashcards.definitionZh: 位于城市或大城市郊区的住宅区，通常包括为其居民提供服务的企业；例如学校、杂货店、购物中心、餐馆、便利店等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是郊区这个词。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: In a comparative manner.
flashcards.example: This is the word Comparatively.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以比较的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是比较这个词。

flashcards.definition: Pertaining to an economy.
flashcards.example: This is the word Economic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与经济有关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是经济这个词。

flashcards.definition: Careful with money so as not to spend too much; prudent; thrifty.
flashcards.example: He was an economical person by nature.
flashcards.definitionZh: 花钱要小心，不要花太多；谨慎;节俭。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他本质上是一个节约的人。

flashcards.definition: A reduction of some sort in an existing program.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cutback.
flashcards.definitionZh: 现有程序的某种减少。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“削减”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of cutting.
flashcards.example: He made a fine cut with his sword.
flashcards.definitionZh: 切割的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他用剑划出了一道细痕。

flashcards.definition: A violent release of energy (sometimes mechanical, nuclear, or chemical.)
flashcards.example: This is the word Explosion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能量的猛烈释放（有时是机械能量、核能量或化学能量。）
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是爆炸这个词。

flashcards.definition: A homogeneous mass of rock, not layered and without an obvious crystal structure.
flashcards.example: karst massives in western Georgia
flashcards.definitionZh: 均匀的岩石块，没有层状，也没有明显的晶体结构。
flashcards.exampleZh: 乔治亚州西部的喀斯特地块

flashcards.definition: A day that is an exact number of years (to the day) since a given significant event occurred. Often preceded by an ordinal number indicating the number of years.
flashcards.example: Today is the fiftieth anniversary of the end of the war.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某天是自给定重大事件发生以来的确切年数（截至该日）。通常前面有表示年数的序数。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天是战争结束五十周年。

flashcards.definition: Having no variations in height.
flashcards.example: The land around here is flat.
flashcards.definitionZh: 高度没有变化。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这里周围的土地很平坦。

flashcards.definition: An expression of praise, congratulation, or respect.
flashcards.example: This is the word Compliment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表达赞扬、祝贺或尊重。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是赞美这个词。

flashcards.definition: (totum pro parte, typically with definite article) The entirety of users in a chatroom or a single member thereof.
flashcards.example: The Chat just made a joke about my skills.
flashcards.definitionZh: （totum proparte，通常带有定冠词）聊天室中的全部用户或其中的单个成员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 聊天室只是拿我的技能开了个玩笑。

flashcards.definition: The food and beverage a person or animal consumes.
flashcards.example: The diet of the Giant Panda consists mainly of bamboo.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人或动物消耗的食物和饮料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大熊猫的食物主要是竹子。

flashcards.definition: Proceeding or advancing by small, slow, regular steps or degrees
flashcards.example: a gradual increase of knowledge; a gradual decline
flashcards.definitionZh: 以小的、缓慢的、有规律的步骤或程度进行或前进
flashcards.exampleZh: 知识的逐步增长；逐渐下降

flashcards.definition: The act of cutting.
flashcards.example: He made a fine cut with his sword.
flashcards.definitionZh: 切割的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他用剑划出了一道细痕。

flashcards.definition: To give oneself up into the power of another, especially as a prisoner; to submit or give in.
flashcards.example: I surrender!
flashcards.definitionZh: 将自己交给他人的权力，尤其是作为囚犯；提交或屈服。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我投降！

flashcards.definition: A secret plan to achieve an end, the end or means usually being illegal or otherwise questionable.
flashcards.example: The assassination of Lincoln was part of a larger plot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到目的的秘密计划，目的或手段通常是非法的或有其他问题的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 刺杀林肯是一个更大阴谋的一部分。

flashcards.definition: Moderately; somewhat.
flashcards.example: a halfway decent place to sleep
flashcards.definitionZh: 适度；有些。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个还算不错的睡觉的地方

flashcards.definition: The act of allotting.
flashcards.example: This is the word Allotment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 分配行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是分配这个词。

flashcards.definition: The part of the body of an animal or human which contains the brain, mouth and main sense organs.
flashcards.example: Be careful when you pet that dog on the head; it may bite.
flashcards.definitionZh: 动物或人类身体的一部分，包含大脑、口腔和主要感觉器官。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当你抚摸那只狗的头时要小心；它可能会咬人。

flashcards.definition: The securing of an object of strife or desire, as by the power of some attraction.
flashcards.example: the capture of a lover's heart
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过某种吸引力的力量来获得冲突或欲望的对象。
flashcards.exampleZh: 俘获爱人的心

flashcards.definition: Intentional causing of somebody's experiencing agony
flashcards.example: In every war there are acts of torture that cause the world to shudder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 故意造成某人经历痛苦
flashcards.exampleZh: 每场战争中都会有令世界颤抖的酷刑行为。

flashcards.definition: Under anesthesia, especially general anesthesia; sedated.
flashcards.example: Ensure the patient is sufficiently under.
flashcards.definitionZh: 麻醉下，尤其是全身麻醉下；镇静剂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 确保患者处于足够低的位置。

flashcards.definition: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.
flashcards.example: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 退出、逃脱、缓刑等的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们制定了法律来给这些组织一个机会。

flashcards.definition: The state of being actual or real.
flashcards.example: The reality of the crash scene on TV dawned upon him only when he saw the victim was no actor but his friend.
flashcards.definitionZh: 真实或真实的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他看到受害者不是演员而是他的朋友时，他才意识到电视上坠机场景的真实性。

flashcards.definition: In a full manner; without lack or defect.
flashcards.example: He fully met his responsibilities.
flashcards.definitionZh: 充分地；无缺乏或缺陷。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他完全履行了自己的职责。

flashcards.definition: General character, mood, or trend.
flashcards.example: Her rousing speech gave an upbeat tone to the rest of the evening.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一般性格、情绪或趋势。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她激动人心的演讲给当晚剩下的时间带来了乐观的基调。

flashcards.definition: A short act or piece between others, as in a play; a break between acts.
flashcards.example: This is the word Interact.
flashcards.definitionZh: 他人之间的短剧或片段，如戏剧；行为之间的休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是互动这个词。

flashcards.definition: Interacting with or communicating with and reacting to each other; influencing or having an effect on each other; acting or capable of acting on each other or with the other.
flashcards.example: interactive teaching methods
flashcards.definitionZh: 彼此互动或沟通并做出反应；相互影响或产生影响；彼此作用或能够作用于对方或与对方共同作用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 互动式教学方法

flashcards.definition: A structured arrangement of items within certain limits.
flashcards.example: This is the word Layout.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在一定范围内对项目进行结构化排列。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是布局这个词。

flashcards.definition: A bad habit.
flashcards.example: Gluttony is a vice, not a virtue.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个坏习惯。
flashcards.exampleZh: 暴食是一种恶习，而不是一种美德。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: Without attention to warnings or indications of bad consequences.
flashcards.example: Tatiana knew the meat had passed its expiry date, but she ate it regardless.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不注意警告或不良后果的迹象。
flashcards.exampleZh: 塔蒂亚娜知道肉已经过了保质期，但她还是吃了。

flashcards.definition: The act of consulting or deliberating; consultation
flashcards.example: This is the word Consult.
flashcards.definitionZh: 咨询或审议的行为；咨询
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“咨询”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: To make worse; to make inferior in quality or value; to impair.
flashcards.example: to deteriorate the mind
flashcards.definitionZh: 使情况变得更糟；降低质量或价值；损害。
flashcards.exampleZh: 使精神恶化

flashcards.definition: An organism that is specialized for a particular environment.
flashcards.example: The tree Lepidothamnus laxifolius is a high alpine specialist found in high-altitude bog communities and in scrub.
flashcards.definitionZh: 专门针对特定环境的有机体。
flashcards.exampleZh: Lepidothamnus laxifolius 树是一种高山植物，生长于高海拔沼泽群落和灌木丛中。

flashcards.definition: To follow behind (someone or something); to tail (someone or something).
flashcards.example: The hunters trailed their prey deep into the woods.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跟在（某人或某物）后面；尾随（某人或某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 猎人将猎物拖入树林深处。

flashcards.definition: To die.
flashcards.example: The patient expired in hospital.
flashcards.definitionZh: 去死吧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 患者在医院去世。

flashcards.definition: A date by which an object either should not be used or loses its value, depending upon the item.
flashcards.example: credit card expiration date
flashcards.definitionZh: 对象不应该被使用或失去其价值的日期，具体取决于项目。
flashcards.exampleZh: 信用卡到期日

flashcards.definition: To extend a period of loan, especially a library book that is due to be returned.
flashcards.example: I'd like to renew these three books.  Did you know that you can renew online?
flashcards.definitionZh: 延长借阅期限，尤其是应归还的图书馆书籍。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我想续订这三本书。  您知道可以在线续订吗？

flashcards.definition: Proceeding in a straight course or manner; not deviating.
flashcards.example: This is the word Straightforward.
flashcards.definitionZh: 沿直线路线或方式前进；不偏离。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是直白这个词。

flashcards.definition: To hold up; to lift on high; to elevate.
flashcards.example: This is the word Uphold.
flashcards.definitionZh: 坚持住；举到高处；提升。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是秉持这个词。

flashcards.definition: The building or buildings which house such an organization.
flashcards.example: He's been in an institution since the crash.
flashcards.definitionZh: 容纳此类组织的建筑物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 事故发生后他一直被送进收容机构。

flashcards.definition: To be off one's guard.
flashcards.example: The regulators were caught napping by the financial collapse.
flashcards.definitionZh: 让人措手不及。
flashcards.exampleZh: 监管机构因金融崩溃而打瞌睡。

flashcards.definition: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
flashcards.example: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当某物受力时所经历的弯曲量；在压力下有屈服的倾向；韧性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有屈服于教条式的宗教信仰。

flashcards.definition: To yield or give way to another.
flashcards.example: They will not submit to the destruction of their rights.
flashcards.definitionZh: 屈服或让位于另一个人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们不会屈服于自己的权利被破坏。

flashcards.definition: The act of assigning; the allocation of a job or a set of tasks.
flashcards.example: This flow chart represents the assignment of tasks in our committee.
flashcards.definitionZh: 分配行为；一项工作或一组任务的分配。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该流程图代表了我们委员会的任务分配。

flashcards.definition: To take back (a comment, etc); retract.
flashcards.example: to withdraw false charges
flashcards.definitionZh: 收回（评论等）；缩回。
flashcards.exampleZh: 撤回虚假指控

flashcards.definition: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
flashcards.example: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当某物受力时所经历的弯曲量；在压力下有屈服的倾向；韧性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有屈服于教条式的宗教信仰。

flashcards.definition: To consume another beverage immediately after drinking hard liquor, typically something better tasting or less harsh such as soda or beer; to use a drink as a chaser
flashcards.example: I need something to chase this shot with.
flashcards.definitionZh: 喝完烈酒后立即喝另一种饮料，通常是味道更好或不太刺激的饮料，例如苏打水或啤酒；用饮料作为追逐者
flashcards.exampleZh: 我需要一些东西来追这个镜头。

flashcards.definition: To construct or draw up a budget.
flashcards.example: Budgeting is even harder in times of recession
flashcards.definitionZh: 制定或制定预算。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在经济衰退时期制定预算更加困难

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word word-building exercise.
flashcards.example: This is the word word-building exercise.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单词构建练习的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是单词构词练习。

flashcards.definition: A floor or level of a building or ship.
flashcards.example: For superstitious reasons, many buildings number their 13th storey as 14, bypassing 13 entirely.
flashcards.definitionZh: 建筑物或船舶的楼层或水平面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 出于迷信的原因，许多建筑物将 13 层编号为 14 层，完全绕过了 13 层。

flashcards.definition: A very tall building with a large number of floors.
flashcards.example: This is the word Skyscraper.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一栋非常高的建筑，有很多层。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是摩天大楼这个词。

flashcards.definition: To gain (an object or desired result).
flashcards.example: To attain such a high level of proficiency requires hours of practice each day.
flashcards.definitionZh: 获得（目标或期望的结果）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 要达到如此高的熟练程度，需要每天数小时的练习。

flashcards.definition: A (human) female who has given birth to a baby
flashcards.example: He had something of his mother in him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 已生下婴儿的（人类）女性
flashcards.exampleZh: 他身上有一些他母亲的影子。

flashcards.definition: A mechanism powered by a coiled spring and regulated by some form of escapement; the power is transmitted through toothed gearwheels and used to drive a mechanical clock, toy, or other device.
flashcards.example: This is the word Clockwork.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由螺旋弹簧提供动力并由某种形式的擒纵机构调节的机构；动力通过齿轮传输并用于驱动机械钟、玩具或其他设备。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是发条这个词。

flashcards.definition: Equal to or fulfilling some requirement.
flashcards.example: an adequate definition
flashcards.definitionZh: 等于或满足某些要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 充分的定义

flashcards.definition: Not adequate; not fit for the purpose
flashcards.example: inadequate representation
flashcards.definitionZh: 不充分；不适合目的
flashcards.exampleZh: 代表性不足

flashcards.definition: Mental or bodily distress.
flashcards.example: This is the word Discomfort.
flashcards.definitionZh: 精神或身体上的痛苦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“不舒服”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To expel; to put out.
flashcards.example: to exclude young animals from the womb or from eggs
flashcards.definitionZh: 驱逐；拿出来。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将幼小动物排除在子宫或鸡蛋之外

flashcards.definition: The process, in the gastrointestinal tract, by which food is converted into substances that can be utilized by the body.
flashcards.example: This is the word Digestion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 食物在胃肠道中转化为人体可以利用的物质的过程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是消化这个词。

flashcards.definition: Characterized by aggression; unjustly attacking; prone to behave in a way that involves attacking or arguing.
flashcards.example: an aggressive policy, war, person, nation
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有攻击性；不公正的攻击；容易出现攻击或争论的行为方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 侵略性政策、战争、个人、国家

flashcards.definition: The act of initiating hostilities or invasion.
flashcards.example: This is the word Aggression.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发起敌对行动或入侵的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“侵略”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To utter a deep guttural sound, as an angry animal; to give forth an angry, grumbling sound.
flashcards.example: The dog growled at me as I walked past.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发出低沉的喉音，像一只愤怒的动物；发出愤怒、抱怨的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我走过时，那只狗对我咆哮。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: Uncontrollable.
flashcards.example: a helpless urge
flashcards.definitionZh: 无法控制。
flashcards.exampleZh: 无奈的冲动

flashcards.definition: To connect or combine into one; to put together.
flashcards.example: The plumber joined the two ends of the broken pipe.
flashcards.definitionZh: 连接或组合成一个；放在一起。
flashcards.exampleZh: 水管工将破损管道的两端连接起来。

flashcards.definition: To teach by giving instructions.
flashcards.example: Listen carefully when someone instructs you how to assemble the furniture.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过给予指示来教导。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当有人指导您如何组装家具时，请仔细聆听。

flashcards.definition: One who instructs; a teacher.
flashcards.example: This is the word Instructor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位指导者；一位老师。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是导师这个词。

flashcards.definition: To moisten.
flashcards.example: This is the word Moist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 去润湿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是湿润这个词。

flashcards.definition: To make moist or moister.
flashcards.example: This is the word Moisten.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使湿润或湿润。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是滋润这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of licking; a stroke of the tongue.
flashcards.example: The cat gave its fur a lick.
flashcards.definitionZh: 舔的动作；舌头的一击。
flashcards.exampleZh: 猫舔了舔毛皮。

flashcards.definition: Occurring or appearing irregularly from time to time, but not often.
flashcards.example: He took an occasional glass of wine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不时发生或不规则出现，但不经常发生。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他偶尔喝一杯酒。

flashcards.definition: An eruption; the sudden appearance of a rash, disease, etc.
flashcards.example: Any epidemic outbreak causes understandable panic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 爆发；突然出现皮疹、疾病等
flashcards.exampleZh: 任何流行病的爆发都会引起可以理解的恐慌。

flashcards.definition: A dive, leap, rush, or pitch into (into water)
flashcards.example: A plunge into the sea
flashcards.definitionZh: 潜入、跳跃、冲入或投入（水中）
flashcards.exampleZh: 一头扎进海里

flashcards.definition: A formal recording of names, events, transactions etc.
flashcards.example: The teacher took the register by calling out each child's name.
flashcards.definitionZh: 姓名、事件、交易等的正式记录。
flashcards.exampleZh: 老师喊出了每个孩子的名字，进行了登记。

flashcards.definition: Land, and all the built structures on it, especially when considered as a single place.
flashcards.example: This is the word Premises.
flashcards.definitionZh: 土地，以及其上的所有建筑，尤其是当被视为一个地方时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“处所”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Causing trouble or anxiety
flashcards.example: The computer has been very troublesome for me. It never works when I need to use it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 造成麻烦或焦虑
flashcards.exampleZh: 电脑给我带来了很大的麻烦。当我需要使用它时它永远不会起作用。

flashcards.definition: To change the form or structure of.
flashcards.example: This is the word Alter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 改变…的形式或结构。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“改变”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An academic discipline that seeks truth through reasoning rather than empiricism.
flashcards.example: Philosophy is often divided into five major branches: logic, metaphysics, epistemology, ethics and aesthetics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一门通过推理而非经验主义寻求真理的学科。
flashcards.exampleZh: 哲学通常分为五个主要分支：逻辑学、形而上学、认识论、伦理学和美学。

flashcards.definition: To take apart from; to take off.
flashcards.example: to detach the tag from a newly purchased garment
flashcards.definitionZh: 分开；起飞。
flashcards.exampleZh: 从新购买的衣服上取下标签

flashcards.definition: Such a house.
flashcards.example: This is the word Semi-detached.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这样的房子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是半独立式这个词。

flashcards.definition: To provide something with a terrace.
flashcards.example: This is the word Terraced.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提供带有露台的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是梯田这个词。

flashcards.definition: A single-storey house, typically with rooms all on one level, or sometimes also with upper rooms set into the roof space.
flashcards.example: My aunt can't manage the stairs any more, so she's moving to a bungalow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单层房屋，通常所有房间都位于一层，有时也将上层房间设置在屋顶空间中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我姨妈再也爬不动楼梯了，所以她要搬到平房去。

flashcards.definition: A large house or building, usually built for the wealthy.
flashcards.example: This is the word Mansion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 大房子或建筑物，通常为富人建造。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是府这个词。

flashcards.definition: Motivation to do or achieve something; ability coupled with ambition.
flashcards.example: Crassus had wealth and wit, but Pompey had drive and Caesar as much again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做某事或取得某事的动机；能力加上野心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 克拉苏拥有财富和智慧，但庞培和凯撒同样拥有动力。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: Any insect, arachnid, or other terrestrial arthropod that is a pest.
flashcards.example: These flies are a bother. I’ll get some bug spray and kill them.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何属于害虫的昆虫、蜘蛛或其他陆生节肢动物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些苍蝇很麻烦。我会拿一些杀虫剂来杀死它们。

flashcards.definition: A disease caused by these organisms.
flashcards.example: He caught a virus and had to stay home from school.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由这些生物体引起的疾病。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他感染了病毒，不得不呆在家里不上学。

flashcards.definition: A type, species, or strain of bacterium.
flashcards.example: This is the word Bacteria.
flashcards.definitionZh: 细菌的一种类型、种类或菌株。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是细菌这个词。

flashcards.definition: A fault or malfunction.
flashcards.example: a defect in the ear or eye; a defect in timber or iron; a defect of memory or judgment
flashcards.definitionZh: 故障或故障。
flashcards.exampleZh: 耳朵或眼睛有缺陷；木材或铁的缺陷；记忆或判断力缺陷

flashcards.definition: A device (transducer) used to convert sound waves into a varying electric current; normally fed into an amplifier and either recorded or broadcast.
flashcards.example: This is the word Microphone.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于将声波转换成变化电流的装置（换能器）；通常输入放大器并进行录制或广播。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是麦克风这个词。

flashcards.definition: An organization or group of officials who permanently represent a sovereign state in a second sovereign state or with respect to an international organization such as the United Nations.
flashcards.example: The American embassy to France is located in Paris.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在第二个主权国家中或在联合国等国际组织中永久代表一个主权国家的组织或官员团体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 美国驻法国大使馆位于巴黎。

flashcards.definition: To exchange or give (something) in an exchange (for something else).
flashcards.example: This is the word Swap.
flashcards.definitionZh: 交换或给予（某物）以交换（换取其他东西）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是交换这个词。

flashcards.definition: A spider.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cop.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一只蜘蛛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是警察这个词。

flashcards.definition: To terminate a union of multiple members actively, as by disbanding.
flashcards.example: The ruling party or coalition sometimes dissolves parliament early when the polls are favorable, hoping to reconvene with a larger majority.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主动终止由多名成员组成的工会，例如解散。
flashcards.exampleZh: 执政党或联盟有时会在民意调查有利时提前解散议会，希望以更多多数重新召开会议。

flashcards.definition: To (gently) tap the flat of one's hand on a person or thing.
flashcards.example: To show affection, he decided he would pat the boy on the head.
flashcards.definitionZh: （轻轻地）用手掌拍打人或物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为了表达爱意，他决定拍拍男孩的头。

flashcards.definition: Happening at the same moment.
flashcards.example: This is the word Simultaneous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发生在同一时刻。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“同时”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The way in which something hangs.
flashcards.example: This skirt has a nice hang.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物悬挂的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这条裙子的悬垂感很好。

flashcards.definition: Value.
flashcards.example: I’ll have a dollar's worth of candy, please.
flashcards.definitionZh: 价值。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请给我一美元的糖果。

flashcards.definition: Good and important enough to spend time, effort, or money on.
flashcards.example: Doing volunteer work to help others is truly worthwhile.
flashcards.definitionZh: 好且重要，足以花费时间、精力或金钱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 做志愿者工作来帮助别人确实是值得的。

flashcards.definition: An outer part.
flashcards.example: This is the word Outer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 外部部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是外在这个词。

flashcards.definition: Being or occurring (farther) inside, situated farther in, located (situated) or happening on the inside of something, situated within or farther within contained within something.
flashcards.example: inner door;  inner room;  inner sanctum;  inner surface
flashcards.definitionZh: 存在或发生（更远）在某物内部、位于更远的地方、位于（位于）某物的内部或发生在某物的内部、位于某物内或更远地包含在某物内。
flashcards.exampleZh: 内门；  内室；  内殿；  内表面

flashcards.definition: The area surrounding a city or town; suburb.
flashcards.example: He lived on the outskirts of Paris for a time.
flashcards.definitionZh: 城市或城镇周围的区域；市郊。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他曾在巴黎郊区居住过一段时间。

flashcards.definition: So precious as not to be sold at any price; invaluable.
flashcards.example: This is the word Priceless.
flashcards.definitionZh: 珍贵到无论如何也卖不出去；无价。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是无价之宝这个词。

flashcards.definition: Having no worth or use; without value; inconsequential.
flashcards.example: Don't be a worthless slouch! Go get yourself a job.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有价值或用途；没有价值；无关紧要的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 别做一个毫无价值的懒汉！给自己找份工作吧。

flashcards.definition: A grotesque representation of a figure; a gargoyle.
flashcards.example: This is the word Antique.
flashcards.definitionZh: 怪诞的人物形象；石像鬼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“古董”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Literary type using invented or imaginative writing, instead of real facts, usually written as prose.
flashcards.example: I am a great reader of fiction.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用发明或想象的写作而不是真实事实的文学类型，通常写成散文。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我非常喜欢小说。

flashcards.definition: Written works intended to give facts, or true accounts of real things and events. Often used attributively.
flashcards.example: Encyclopedias, how-to manuals and biographies are all considered nonfiction and so are kept in the nonfiction section.
flashcards.definitionZh: 旨在提供事实或真实事物和事件的真实描述的书面作品。常用于定语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 百科全书、操作手册和传记都被视为非小说类书籍，因此保留在非小说类书籍部分。

flashcards.definition: Written fiction of a high standard.
flashcards.example: However, even “literary” science fiction rarely qualifies as literature, because it treats characters as sets of traits rather than as fully realized human beings with unique life stories. —Adam Cadre, 2008
flashcards.definitionZh: 写的小说水平很高。
flashcards.exampleZh: 然而，即使是“文学”科幻小说也很少有资格成为文学，因为它将人物视为一组特征，而不是作为具有独特生活故事的完全实现的人类。 ——亚当·卡德尔，2008 年

flashcards.definition: Of or relating to a reconciliation.
flashcards.example: Joe and Joanne had a big fight, and then apologized and had incredible make-up sex.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于和解的或与和解有关的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 乔和乔安妮大吵了一架，然后道歉并进行了令人难以置信的和好性行为。

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: To be raised up; to grow larger.
flashcards.example: A debt enhances rapidly by compound interest.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被兴起；变得更大。
flashcards.exampleZh: 债务通过复利迅速增加。

flashcards.definition: Deficient in physical strength
flashcards.example: Though she appeared old and feeble, she could still throw a ball.
flashcards.definitionZh: 体力不足
flashcards.exampleZh: 尽管她看上去年老体弱，但她仍然可以扔球。

flashcards.definition: A loss of greatness or status.
flashcards.example: the fall of Rome
flashcards.definitionZh: 失去伟大或地位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗马的陷落

flashcards.definition: A line of objects, often regularly spaced, such as seats in a theatre, vegetable plants in a garden etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word ROW.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一排物体，通常间隔规则，例如剧院的座位、花园里的蔬菜植物等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是 ROW 这个词。

flashcards.definition: To go after; to pursue; to move behind in the same path or direction.
flashcards.example: Follow that car!
flashcards.definitionZh: 去追寻；追求；沿相同的路径或方向向后移动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 跟着那辆车！

flashcards.definition: Installer. A software utility that installs an application.
flashcards.example: After inserting the disk, you need to run the install.
flashcards.definitionZh: 安装人员。安装应用程序的软件实用程序。
flashcards.exampleZh: 插入磁盘后，您需要运行安装。

flashcards.definition: A person with extensive knowledge or ability in a given subject.
flashcards.example: We called in several experts on the subject, but they couldn't reach an agreement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在某一特定学科领域具有广泛知识或能力的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们就此问题请来了几位专家，但他们未能达成一致。

flashcards.definition: To become red in the face (and sometimes experience an associated feeling of warmth), especially due to shyness, shame, excitement, or embarrassment.
flashcards.example: He wasn't used to this much attention, so he blushed as he saw dozens of pairs of eyes watching him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 脸变红（有时会感到相关的温暖感），尤其是由于害羞、羞耻、兴奋或尴尬。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他不太习惯这么多的关注，看到几十双眼睛注视着他，他脸红了。

flashcards.definition: A spoken or written remark.
flashcards.example: I have no comment on that.
flashcards.definitionZh: 口头或书面的评论。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对此不发表评论。

flashcards.definition: An irregular, jerky or awkward gait.
flashcards.example: She walks with a limp.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不规则、急躁或笨拙的步态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她走路一瘸一拐的。

flashcards.definition: A course or way which is traveled or passed.
flashcards.example: The route was used so much that it formed a rut.
flashcards.definitionZh: 旅行或通过的路线或方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这条路线被频繁使用，以至于形成了车辙。

flashcards.definition: To express (an action, thought or idea) by means of particular words.
flashcards.example: I wasn't sure how to phrase my condolences without sounding patronising.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过特定的词语来表达（行动、思想或想法）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不知道如何表达我的哀悼而又不显得居高临下。

flashcards.definition: The style of writing of a person.
flashcards.example: I can't read your writing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的写作风格。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我读不懂你的文字。

flashcards.definition: The state of being sequent or following; order of succession.
flashcards.example: Complete the listed tasks in sequence.
flashcards.definitionZh: 连续或跟随的状态；继承顺序。
flashcards.exampleZh: 按顺序完成列出的任务。

flashcards.definition: To put (something) down, to rest.
flashcards.example: Set the tray there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放下（某物），休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将托盘放在那里。

flashcards.definition: The act of departing or something that has departed.
flashcards.example: The departure was scheduled for noon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 离开的行为或已经离开的事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 出发时间定于中午。

flashcards.definition: To step or climb onto or otherwise enter a ship, aircraft, train or other conveyance.
flashcards.example: It is time to board the aircraft.
flashcards.definitionZh: 踏上或爬上或以其他方式进入轮船、飞机、火车或其他交通工具。
flashcards.exampleZh: 已经到了登机时间。

flashcards.definition: Ruined, ravaged.
flashcards.example: the devastated city
flashcards.definitionZh: 毁坏、蹂躏。
flashcards.exampleZh: 被毁坏的城市

flashcards.definition: A quantity obtained by addition or aggregation.
flashcards.example: The sum of 3 and 4 is 7.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过相加或聚合获得的数量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 3 和 4 的和是 7。

flashcards.definition: To remove or reduce; especially to reduce a quantity or number
flashcards.example: If you subtract the $100 for gas from the total cost, it was a fairly inexpensive trip.
flashcards.definitionZh: 去除或减少；尤其是减少数量或数量
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果从总费用中减去 100 美元的汽油费，这趟旅行相当便宜。

flashcards.definition: To make something (such as an object or message) go from one place to another.
flashcards.example: Every day at two o'clock, he sends his secretary out to buy him a coffee.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使某物（例如物体或消息）从一个地方移动到另一个地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每天两点，他都会派秘书出去给他买咖啡。

flashcards.definition: Maintenance; the act or effort of keeping something in good and working condition.
flashcards.example: I would enjoy having a swimming pool, but I don't want to deal with the upkeep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 维护;使某物保持良好和工作状态的行为或努力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我希望拥有一个游泳池，但我不想负责维护工作。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the plural) Monetary resources, especially those of a public entity or a company.
flashcards.example: Who's really in charge of a democracy's finances?
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）货币资源，尤其是公共实体或公司的货币资源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 谁真正负责民主国家的财政？

flashcards.definition: A grasp or grip.
flashcards.example: Keep a firm hold on the handlebars.
flashcards.definitionZh: 抓握或抓握。
flashcards.exampleZh: 牢牢握住车把。

flashcards.definition: Relating to the collection, sorting and delivery of mail.
flashcards.example: for all your postal needs
flashcards.definitionZh: 涉及邮件的收集、分类和递送。
flashcards.exampleZh: 满足您所有的邮政需求

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: An inclination in a particular direction.
flashcards.example: the trend of a coastline
flashcards.definitionZh: 向特定方向的倾向。
flashcards.exampleZh: 海岸线的走向

flashcards.definition: The manner in which two things may be associated.
flashcards.example: The relation between diet and health is complex.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个事物可能关联的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 饮食与健康之间的关系很复杂。

flashcards.definition: Insane, mad, crazy.
flashcards.example: He is the most mental freshman I've seen yet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 疯了，疯了，疯了。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是我见过的最有精神的新生。

flashcards.definition: At a higher level, rank or position.
flashcards.example: This is the word Uppermost.
flashcards.definitionZh: 处于较高级别、级别或职位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是至高无上的词。

flashcards.definition: Of a bleached or pale golden (light yellowish) colour.
flashcards.example: blond ale
flashcards.definitionZh: 漂白或淡金色（浅黄色）颜色。
flashcards.exampleZh: 金色麦芽酒

flashcards.definition: Of a bleached or pale golden (light yellowish) colour.
flashcards.example: blond ale
flashcards.definitionZh: 漂白或淡金色（浅黄色）颜色。
flashcards.exampleZh: 金色麦芽酒

flashcards.definition: A difference between two objects, people or concepts.
flashcards.example: Israel is a country of many contrasts.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个物体、人或概念之间的差异。
flashcards.exampleZh: 以色列是一个充满反差的国家。

flashcards.definition: Someone who watches over something; a person in charge of something or someone.
flashcards.example: The camp monitors look after the children during the night, when the teachers are asleep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 监视某事的人；负责某事或某人的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 夜间，当老师们睡觉时，营地的监护人会照顾孩子们。

flashcards.definition: The state of attending; presence or waiting upon.
flashcards.example: Attendance at the meeting is required.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出席情况；存在或等待。
flashcards.exampleZh: 必须出席会议。

flashcards.definition: To engulf, surge over and submerge.
flashcards.example: The dinghy was overwhelmed by the great wave.
flashcards.definitionZh: 吞没、涌过并淹没。
flashcards.exampleZh: 小艇被巨浪淹没了。

flashcards.definition: Something wound in the form of a helix or spiral.
flashcards.example: the sinuous coils of a snake
flashcards.definitionZh: 以螺旋或盘旋形式缠绕的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 蛇的蜿蜒盘绕

flashcards.definition: (constructed with with) to exchange messages, especially by postal letter, over a period of time.
flashcards.example: I've been corresponding with my German pen pal for three years.
flashcards.definitionZh: （与 with 构成）在一段时间内交换消息，尤其是通过邮政信函。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我和我的德国笔友已经通信三年了。

flashcards.definition: One of usually 4 officials who preside over a baseball game.
flashcards.example: The umpire called the pitch a strike.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常主持棒球比赛的 4 名官员之一。
flashcards.exampleZh: 裁判员称本场比赛为罢工。

flashcards.definition: An umpire or judge; an official who makes sure the rules are followed during a game.
flashcards.example: The referee kicked Jim out of the game for fighting.
flashcards.definitionZh: 裁判员或法官；确保比赛期间规则得到遵守的官员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 吉姆因打架而被裁判踢出比赛。

flashcards.definition: An insect in the order Orthoptera, especially family Gryllidae, that makes a chirping sound by rubbing its wing casings against combs on its hind legs.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cricket.
flashcards.definitionZh: 直翅目昆虫，尤其是蝼蛄科昆虫，通过用翅膀外壳摩擦后腿上的鸡冠来发出鸣叫声。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是板球这个词。

flashcards.definition: The amount of money taken as sales transacted in a given period.
flashcards.example: The company had an annual turnover of $500,000.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在给定期间内作为销售交易的金额。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该公司的年营业额为 500,000 美元。

flashcards.definition: To give by sentence or judicial determination; to assign or apportion, after careful regard to the nature of the case; to adjudge
flashcards.example: the arbitrators awarded damages to the complainant
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过判决或司法裁决作出；仔细考虑案件的性质后进行分配或分摊；判断
flashcards.exampleZh: 仲裁员判给申诉人赔偿损失

flashcards.definition: A grant-in-aid to a student.
flashcards.example: This is the word Scholarship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向学生提供的助学金。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是奖学金这个词。

flashcards.definition: An answer or reply, or something in the nature of an answer or reply.
flashcards.example: This is the word Response.
flashcards.definitionZh: 答案或回复，或具有答案或回复性质的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“回应”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of destroying.
flashcards.example: The destruction of the condemned building will take place at noon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 破坏行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这座被谴责的建筑将于中午被摧毁。

flashcards.definition: The state of being, existing, or occurring; beinghood.
flashcards.example: In order to destroy evil, we must first acknowledge its existence.
flashcards.definitionZh: 存在、存在或发生的状态；存在性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为了消灭邪恶，我们首先必须承认它的存在。

flashcards.definition: In effect or essence, if not in fact or reality; imitated, simulated.
flashcards.example: In fact a defeat on the battlefield, Tet was a virtual victory for the North, owing to its effect on public opinion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 即使不是事实或现实，也是在效果或本质上；模仿的，模仿的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 事实上，由于其对公众舆论的影响，春节对于朝鲜来说实际上是一次战场上的失败。

flashcards.definition: (diminutive) An even number.
flashcards.example: So let's see. There are two evens here and three odds.
flashcards.definitionZh: （小数）偶数。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那么让我们看看。这里有两个偶数和三个奇数。

flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: Primary site of disease; original location or source of the disease.
flashcards.example: most common primaries
flashcards.definitionZh: 原发病灶；疾病的原始位置或来源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 最常见的初选

flashcards.definition: The relation of one part to another or to the whole with respect to magnitude, quantity, or degree.
flashcards.example: the proportion of the parts of a building, or of the body
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个部分与另一部分或整体在大小、数量或程度方面的关系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 建筑物或身体各部分的比例

flashcards.definition: That which limits the extent of anything; limit, extremity, bound, boundary.
flashcards.example: "Alright, look...we can spend the holidays with your parents, but this time it will be on my terms."
flashcards.definitionZh: 限制事物范围的事物；限制，极端，界线，界线。
flashcards.exampleZh: “好吧，你看……我们可以和你父母一起过节，不过这一次由我来决定。”

flashcards.definition: The rear of the body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.
flashcards.example: Could you please scratch my back?
flashcards.definitionZh: 身体的后部，特别是颈部和脊柱末端之间、与胸部和腹部相对的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能帮我挠挠背吗？

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.word: Be on good or bad terms with
flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word be worried.
flashcards.example: This is the word be worried.
flashcards.definitionZh: 担心这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是担心这个词。

flashcards.definition: Denoting a manner of speaking or writing that is characteristic of familiar conversation, of common parlance; informal.
flashcards.example: The colloquial and at times sarcastic tone of her books make her popular with teenagers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示一种具有熟悉对话、常用用语特征的说话或写作方式；非正式的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的书的口语和有时讽刺的语气使她深受青少年的欢迎。

flashcards.definition: Preparations applied externally to change or enhance the beauty of skin, hair, nails, lips, and eyes.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cosmetics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于改变或增强皮肤、头发、指甲、嘴唇和眼睛的美丽的外用制剂。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是化妆品这个词。

flashcards.definition: Having a strong or far-reaching effect; extreme, severe.
flashcards.example: If our third attempt fails, we may need drastic ideas.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有强烈或深远的影响；极端，严重。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果我们的第三次尝试失败，我们可能需要激进的想法。

flashcards.definition: The income returned by an investment.
flashcards.example: This is the word Revenue.
flashcards.definitionZh: 投资回报的收入。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“收入”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
flashcards.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物分成两块或更多块的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 股骨已完全断裂，因此应该很容易愈合。

flashcards.definition: An appointment, especially to speak or perform.
flashcards.example: The lecturer has three speaking engagements this week.
flashcards.definitionZh: 约会，尤其是演讲或表演。
flashcards.exampleZh: 讲师本周有三场演讲。

flashcards.definition: A disadvantage; something that detracts or takes away.
flashcards.example: Poor fuel economy is a common drawback among larger vehicles.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个缺点；减损或夺走的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 燃油经济性差是大型车辆的常见缺点。

flashcards.definition: To remove markings or information
flashcards.example: I erased that note because it was wrong.
flashcards.definitionZh: 删除标记或信息
flashcards.exampleZh: 我删除了那张纸条，因为它是错误的。

flashcards.definition: A geometrical figure consisting of two straight lines or bars intersecting each other such that at least one of them is bisected by the other.
flashcards.example: Put a cross for a wrong answer and a tick for a right one.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由两条彼此相交的直线或条组成的几何图形，其中至少一条被另一条平分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 错误答案打叉，正确答案打勾。

flashcards.definition: (often in the plural) The flesh around the teeth.
flashcards.example: This is the word Gum.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）牙齿周围的肉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是口香糖这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of chewing; mastication with the mouth.
flashcards.example: I popped the gum into my mouth and gave it a chew.
flashcards.definitionZh: 咀嚼的动作；用嘴咀嚼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我把口香糖塞进嘴里，嚼了一口。

flashcards.definition: To crush with the teeth by repeated closing and opening of the jaws; done to food to soften it and break it down by the action of saliva before it is swallowed.
flashcards.example: Make sure to chew thoroughly, and don't talk with your mouth full!
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过反复闭合和张开颚部，用牙齿进行压碎；对食物进行软化，并在吞咽之前通过唾液的作用将其分解。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一定要充分咀嚼，不要满嘴说话！

flashcards.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.
flashcards.example: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较远的地方移动到较近的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她来时，她会绕山而来[...]

flashcards.definition: An entertainment, outing, food, drink, or other indulgence provided by someone for the enjoyment of others.
flashcards.example: Here are some healthy Halloween treats for ghouls and witches of all ages.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某人为了他人的享受而提供的娱乐、郊游、食物、饮料或其他放纵。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这里有一些适合各个年龄段的食尸鬼和女巫的健康万圣节美食。

flashcards.definition: To divide into portions and dispense.
flashcards.example: He distributed the bread amongst his followers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 分成几份并分配。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他将面包分发给他的追随者。

flashcards.definition: Going from house to house, when selling, delivering or asking for something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Door-to-door.
flashcards.definitionZh: 挨家挨户销售、运送或索要东西时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“门到门”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Covered with, or containing unclean matter; dirty.
flashcards.example: A ship's bottom is foul when overgrown with barnacles
flashcards.definitionZh: 覆盖或含有不洁物质；肮脏的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当船底长满藤壶时，船底就变得肮脏

flashcards.definition: To switch on
flashcards.example: Can you on the light?
flashcards.definitionZh: 开启
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能开灯吗？

flashcards.definition: To satisfy, carry out, bring to completion (an obligation, a requirement, etc.).
flashcards.example: You made a promise, son, and now you must fulfill it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 满足、执行、完成（义务、要求等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 儿子，你曾许下诺言，现在你必须兑现。

flashcards.definition: Lacking fulfillment; marked by a feeling of failure to achieve goals or desires.
flashcards.example: This is the word Unfulfilled.
flashcards.definitionZh: 缺乏成就感；以无法实现目标或愿望的感觉为特征。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“未实现”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: Inside of something
flashcards.example: We saw the internal compartments.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物内部
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们看到了内部隔间。

flashcards.definition: Outside of something; on the exterior.
flashcards.example: This building has some external pipework.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在某物之外；在外部。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该建筑有一些外部管道。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: An aggregation of data on a storage device, identified by a name.
flashcards.example: I'm going to delete these unwanted files to free up some disk space.
flashcards.definitionZh: 存储设备上的数据聚合，由名称标识。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我将删除这些不需要的文件以释放一些磁盘空间。

flashcards.definition: A motor vehicle for transporting large numbers of people along roads.
flashcards.example: This is the word Highway.
flashcards.definitionZh: 沿道路运送大量人员的机动车辆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是高速公路这个词。

flashcards.definition: A loud cry or uproar.
flashcards.example: His appearance was greeted with an outcry of jeering.
flashcards.definitionZh: 大声喊叫或喧闹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的出现引起了强烈的嘲笑。

flashcards.definition: To end a law, system, institution, custom or practice.
flashcards.example: Slavery was abolished in the nineteenth century.
flashcards.definitionZh: 结束法律、制度、制度、习俗或惯例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 奴隶制于十九世纪被废除。

flashcards.definition: To change place.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pass.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要换地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是通行证这个词。

flashcards.definition: A translation from one language to another.
flashcards.example: It's only in the King James Version of the Bible.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从一种语言到另一种语言的翻译。
flashcards.exampleZh: 它只存在于钦定本圣经中。

flashcards.definition: A talent for leaping.
flashcards.example: Them pro-ballers got bounce!
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有跳跃天赋。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们的职业球员得到了反弹！

flashcards.definition: A cosmopolitan person; a cosmopolite.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cosmopolitan.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个国际化的人；一个世界主义者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“大都会”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Belonging to a minority group.
flashcards.example: Idris Elba was a diverse hire for the franchise
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于少数群体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 伊德里斯·艾尔巴 (Idris Elba) 是该系列的多元化员工

flashcards.definition: Anything that assures a certain outcome.
flashcards.example: Can you give me a guarantee that he will be fit for the match?
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何能保证一定结果的事情。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能向我保证他能够参加比赛吗？

flashcards.definition: To move, pass, or go forward or onward; to advance; to carry on
flashcards.example: To proceed on a journey.
flashcards.definitionZh: 移动、通过、前进或前进；前进；继续
flashcards.exampleZh: 继续旅行。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: To force, constrain or coerce.
flashcards.example: Logic compels the wise, while fools feel compelled by emotions.
flashcards.definitionZh: 强迫、约束或胁迫。
flashcards.exampleZh: 逻辑强迫智者，而傻瓜则被情感强迫。

flashcards.definition: An advisement providing more up-to-date information than currently known.
flashcards.example: He gave me an update on the situation in New York.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提供比目前已知的更多最新信息的建议。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他向我介绍了纽约的最新情况。

flashcards.definition: An improved component or replacement item, usually applied to technology
flashcards.example: With my phone company, I get a free upgrade every twelve months if I keep topping up 10 pounds a month.
flashcards.definitionZh: 改进的组件或替换物品，通常应用于技术
flashcards.exampleZh: 在我的电话公司，如果我每月继续充值 10 英镑，那么我每十二个月就可以获得一次免费升级。

flashcards.definition: An application (program), especially a small one designed for a mobile device.
flashcards.example: This is the word App application.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种应用程序（程序），尤其是为移动设备设计的小型应用程序。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是App应用这个词。

flashcards.definition: A particular benefit, advantage, or favor; a right or immunity enjoyed by some but not others; a prerogative, preferential treatment.
flashcards.example: All first-year professors here must teach four courses a term, yet you're only teaching one! What entitled you to such a privilege?
flashcards.definitionZh: 特定的利益、优势或恩惠； a right or immunity enjoyed by some but not others;特权、优惠待遇。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这里所有的一年级教授每学期必须教授四门课程，而你只教授一门！是什么让您享有这样的特权？

flashcards.definition: The capacity of a vessel, or the weight of cargo that she will carry.
flashcards.example: a ship of a hundred tons burden
flashcards.definitionZh: 船只的容量，或她将携带的货物的重量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一百吨载重的船

flashcards.definition: The act or ability to receive radio or similar signals.
flashcards.example: The new system provides exceptional quality of the reception signal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 接收无线电或类似信号的行为或能力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 新系统提供卓越的接收信号质量。

flashcards.definition: The greatest amount.
flashcards.example: The most I can offer for the house is $150,000.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最大的金额。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我能出的最高价格是 150,000 美元。

flashcards.definition: The major part of something.
flashcards.example: I understood the bulk of what you were saying, just one of two points I need to hear again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的主要部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明白你所说的大部分内容，只是我需要再次听到的两点之一。

flashcards.definition: Ordinary, monotonous routine; that which is usual or mundane.
flashcards.example: People come here to escape the day-to-day.
flashcards.definitionZh: 平凡、单调的日常；平常或平凡的事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 人们来到这里是为了逃避日常生活。

flashcards.definition: The act of moving; a movement.
flashcards.example: A slight move of the tiller, and the boat will go off course.
flashcards.definitionZh: 移动的行为；一个动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 舵柄轻轻一动，船就会偏离航线。

flashcards.definition: Willing to comply with the commands, orders, or instructions of those in authority.
flashcards.example: Jessica was so intensely obedient of her parents that her brother sometimes thought she was a robot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 愿意遵守当权者的命令、命令或指示。
flashcards.exampleZh: 杰西卡非常服从她的父母，以至于她的哥哥有时认为她是一个机器人。

flashcards.definition: To act or behave in an inappropriate, improper, incorrect, or unexpected manner.
flashcards.example: He doesn't mean to misbehave; he just doesn't know better.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以不恰当、不当、不正确或意外的方式行事或表现。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他并不是有意要行为不端；他并不是有意要行为不端。他只是不知道更好。

flashcards.definition: Strict, very close or earnest.
flashcards.example: intense study;  intense thought
flashcards.definitionZh: 严格、非常密切或认真。
flashcards.exampleZh: 紧张的学习；  强烈的思考

flashcards.definition: Demanding; requiring a great amount of work etc.
flashcards.example: This job is difficult because it is so labour-intensive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要求严格；需要大量的工作等
flashcards.exampleZh: 这项工作很困难，因为它是劳动密集型的。

flashcards.definition: To enlist (someone) or make (someone) a member of
flashcards.example: They were eager to enroll new recruits.
flashcards.definitionZh: 招募（某人）或使（某人）成为以下组织的成员
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们急于招收新兵。

flashcards.definition: A small plain-colored bird of the family Apodidae that resembles a swallow and is noted for its rapid flight.
flashcards.example: This is the word Swift.
flashcards.definitionZh: 姬蜂科的一种纯色小鸟，外形酷似燕子，以飞行速度快而闻名。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是斯威夫特这个词。

flashcards.definition: Kept, or meant to be kept, secret within a certain circle of persons; not intended to be known publicly
flashcards.example: The newspaper claims a leaked confidential report by the government admits to problems with corrupt MPs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在一定的人圈子内保守或有意保守的秘密；无意公开
flashcards.exampleZh: 该报称，政府一份泄露的机密报告承认存在腐败议员的问题。

flashcards.definition: Someone who supplies what is needed, especially food.
flashcards.example: The merchants are the purveyors of fine selections.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提供所需物品的人，尤其是食物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 商人是精品的提供者。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word flap.
flashcards.example: This is the word flap.
flashcards.definitionZh: 皮瓣这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是字瓣。

flashcards.definition: A small amount, bit; the smallest amount.
flashcards.example: He didn't care a jot for his work.
flashcards.definitionZh: 少量，一点；最小的量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他一点也不关心他的工作。

flashcards.definition: A style of writing in large characters; also, a kind of type used in printing.
flashcards.example: German text
flashcards.definitionZh: 大字的书写风格；也是印刷中使用的一种类型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 德语文本

flashcards.definition: To be very hungry.
flashcards.example: Hey, ma, I'm starving! What's for dinner?
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常饥饿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 嘿，妈妈，我饿了！晚餐吃什么？

flashcards.definition: Mutual; shared by more than one.
flashcards.example: The two competitors have the common aim of winning the championship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相互的;被多个人共享。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两位选手有着共同的目标，那就是夺得冠军。

flashcards.definition: A reduction in price.
flashcards.example: This store offers discounts on all its wares. That store specializes in discount wares, too.
flashcards.definitionZh: 价格降低。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这家商店的所有商品均提供折扣。那家商店也专门销售折扣商品。

flashcards.definition: To function improperly due to an error, especially accompanied by error message.
flashcards.example: Remove that line of code and the script should stop erroring there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于错误而无法正常运行，尤其是伴随错误消息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 删除该行代码，脚本应该会停止出错。

flashcards.definition: One of the simplest or essential parts or principles of which anything consists, or upon which the constitution or fundamental powers of anything are based.
flashcards.example: Letters are the elements of written language.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何事物组成的最简单或基本的部分或原则之一，或者任何事物的宪法或基本权力所基于的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 字母是书面语言的元素。

flashcards.definition: The lightest chemical element (symbol H), with an atomic number of 1 and atomic weight of 1.00794.
flashcards.example: This is the word Hydrogen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最轻的化学元素（符号H），原子序数为1，原子量为1.00794。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是氢这个词。

flashcards.definition: A symbolic expression of the structure of a compound.
flashcards.example: H2O is the formula for water.
flashcards.definitionZh: 化合物结构的符号表达。
flashcards.exampleZh: H2O是水的分子式。

flashcards.definition: To fight; to struggle against.
flashcards.example: It has proven very difficult to combat drug addiction.
flashcards.definitionZh: 去战斗；去斗争。
flashcards.exampleZh: 事实证明，戒除毒瘾非常困难。

flashcards.definition: To work or act together, especially for a common purpose or benefit.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cooperate co-operate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一起工作或行动，尤其是为了共同的目的或利益。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“合作”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A man, a fellow; an ordinary man, a man on the street.
flashcards.example: This is the word Bloke.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个男人，一个同胞；一个普通人，一个街上的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“家伙”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (of animals and sometimes objects) Thing, creature.
flashcards.example: The dog's left foreleg was broken, poor little guy.
flashcards.definitionZh: （动物，有时是物体）事物，生物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 狗的左前腿断了，可怜的小家伙。

flashcards.definition: (obsolete outside Britain and Australia) A man, a fellow.
flashcards.example: Who’s that chap over there?
flashcards.definitionZh: （在英国和澳大利亚以外已过时）一个男人，一个家伙。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那边那个人是谁？

flashcards.definition: Having an unvarying tone or pitch.
flashcards.example: This is the word Monotonous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有不变的语气或音调。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是单调这个词。

flashcards.definition: Happening many times in a similar way; containing repetition; repeating.
flashcards.example: This is the word Repetitive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 类似的情况多次发生；包含重复；重复。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“重复”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A place from which something can be viewed.
flashcards.example: Perched on the edge of the cliff was a hidden outlook.
flashcards.definitionZh: 可以看到某物的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 悬崖边上有一个隐藏的景观。

flashcards.definition: Expecting the best in all possible ways.
flashcards.example: in an optimistic mood
flashcards.definitionZh: 以一切可能的方式期待最好的结果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 乐观的心情

flashcards.definition: Marked by pessimism and little hopefulness; expecting the worst.
flashcards.example: a pessimistic view of the future
flashcards.definitionZh: 以悲观和无希望为特征；期待最坏的情况。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对未来的悲观看法

flashcards.definition: A tendency to expect the best, or at least, a favourable outcome
flashcards.example: I love her youth, her beauty and above all her optimism that everything will turn out fine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 倾向于期望最好的，或者至少是有利的结果
flashcards.exampleZh: 我爱她的青春、她的美丽，最重要的是她对一切都会好起来的乐观态度。

flashcards.definition: A general belief that bad things will happen.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pessimism.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人们普遍相信坏事会发生。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是悲观主义这个词。

flashcards.definition: To show how to use (something).
flashcards.example: Can you demonstrate the new tools for us?
flashcards.definitionZh: 展示如何使用（某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您能为我们演示一下新工具吗？

flashcards.definition: An event at which something will be demonstrated.
flashcards.example: I have to give a demonstration to the class tomorrow, and I'm ill-prepared.
flashcards.definitionZh: 展示某物的活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 明天我必须给全班做演示，而我准备不足。

flashcards.definition: A formal objection, especially one by a group.
flashcards.example: They lodged a protest with the authorities.
flashcards.definitionZh: 正式的反对意见，尤其是团体提出的反对意见。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们向当局提出抗议。

flashcards.definition: Feeling great anger; raging; violent.
flashcards.example: a furious animal; parent furious at their child's behaviour
flashcards.definitionZh: 感到极大的愤怒；愤怒;暴力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 愤怒的动物；父母对孩子的行为感到愤怒

flashcards.definition: A soft drink made from a fruit-based concentrate diluted with water.
flashcards.example: When I'm thirsty I drink squash; it tastes much nicer than plain water.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由水果浓缩物用水稀释制成的软饮料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我口渴时，我喝南瓜；它的味道比白开水好得多。

flashcards.definition: Anything that raises or uplifts.
flashcards.example: This is the word Elevator.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何能够提升或提升的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是电梯这个词。

flashcards.definition: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.
flashcards.example: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 退出、逃脱、缓刑等的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们制定了法律来给这些组织一个机会。

flashcards.definition: Working time outside of one's regular hours.
flashcards.example: Workers are usually paid extra for working overtime.
flashcards.definitionZh: 正常工作时间之外的工作时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 工人通常会因加班而获得额外报酬。

flashcards.definition: To divide or separate the parts of (especially something flimsy such as paper or fabric), by cutting or tearing; to tear off or out by violence.
flashcards.example: to rip a garment; to rip up a floor
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过切割或撕扯来分割或分离（尤其是脆弱的东西，如纸或织物）的各个部分；用暴力撕下或撕下。
flashcards.exampleZh: 撕破衣服；撕毁地板

flashcards.definition: A bad deal; an unfair or exorbitant price or rate.
flashcards.example: This is the word Rip-off.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一笔糟糕的交易；不公平或过高的价格或费率。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“Rip-off”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A piece of cloth, or other suitable material, sewed or otherwise fixed upon a garment to repair or strengthen it, especially upon an old garment to cover a hole.
flashcards.example: His sleeves had patches on the elbows where different fabric had been sewn on to replace material that had worn away.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一块布或其他合适的材料，缝制或以其他方式固定在衣服上以修复或加固它，特别是在旧衣服上以覆盖破洞。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的袖子肘部有补丁，缝上了不同的布料以替换磨损的材料。

flashcards.definition: The knowledge of one's own worth, valuing one's self; pride.
flashcards.example: If you have no self-respect you can't respect others, because what value would you offer someone by giving the respect of one who is as lowly as you view yourself?
flashcards.definitionZh: 了解自己的价值，重视自己；自豪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果你没有自尊，你就无法尊重别人，因为如果你尊重一个和你一样卑微的人，你会给别人带来什么价值呢？

flashcards.definition: The practice of serving oneself, usually when purchasing items.
flashcards.example: This is the word Self-service.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为自己服务的做法，通常是在购买物品时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是自助服务这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of holiday accommodation: in which the holidaymaker cooks for him/herself.
flashcards.example: This is the word Self-catering.
flashcards.definitionZh: 度假住宿：度假者自己做饭。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是自助一词。

flashcards.definition: Egotistically obsessed with oneself.
flashcards.example: This is the word Self-centred.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自负地沉迷于自己。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“以自我为中心”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (plural "villas") A house, often larger and more expensive than average, in the countryside or on the coast, often used as a retreat.
flashcards.example: This is the word Villa.
flashcards.definitionZh: （复数“别墅”）位于乡村或海岸的房屋，通常比一般房屋更大且更昂贵，通常用作休养所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是别墅这个词。

flashcards.definition: The thought process of considering, of taking multiple or specified factors into account (with of being the main corresponding adposition).
flashcards.example: After much consideration, I have decided to stay.
flashcards.definitionZh: 考虑、考虑多个或特定因素的思维过程（以of为主要对应副词）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 经过深思熟虑，我决定留下来。

flashcards.definition: A kind of expression that enters into an a-bar movement dependency and is said to bind a variable.
flashcards.example: In the sentence "What did Bill say he wants to buy?", "what" is an operator, binding a phonetically empty variable.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种进入 a-bar 移动依赖性的表达式，据说绑定了一个变量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在“Bill 说他想买什么？”这句话中，“what”是一个运算符，绑定了一个语音空变量。

flashcards.definition: A grasp or grip.
flashcards.example: Keep a firm hold on the handlebars.
flashcards.definitionZh: 抓握或抓握。
flashcards.exampleZh: 牢牢握住车把。

flashcards.definition: A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.
flashcards.example: He bought a January '08 put for Procter and Gamble at 80 to hedge his bet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在特定日期或之前以设定价格出售证券的合同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以 80 美元的价格买入了宝洁公司 08 年 1 月的看跌期权来对冲他的赌注。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: A failure, particularly mechanical; something that has failed
flashcards.example: We saw a breakdown by the side of the road.
flashcards.definitionZh: 故障，尤其是机械故障；失败的东西
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们在路边看到了故障。

flashcards.definition: A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.
flashcards.example: He bought a January '08 put for Procter and Gamble at 80 to hedge his bet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在特定日期或之前以设定价格出售证券的合同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以 80 美元的价格买入了宝洁公司 08 年 1 月的看跌期权来对冲他的赌注。

flashcards.definition: The act of snoring, and the noise produced.
flashcards.example: This is the word Snore.
flashcards.definitionZh: 打鼾的行为以及产生的噪音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是打鼾这个词。

flashcards.definition: To admit the knowledge of; to recognize as a fact or truth; to declare one's belief in
flashcards.example: to acknowledge the being of a god
flashcards.definitionZh: 承认知识；承认事实或真理；宣告自己的信仰
flashcards.exampleZh: 承认神的存在

flashcards.definition: To exchange substantially; to abate but not abolish completely, a penalty, obligation, or payment in return for a great, single thing or an aggregate; to cash in; to lessen
flashcards.example: to commute tithes into rentcharges for a sum; to commute market rents for a premium, to commute daily fares for a season ticket
flashcards.definitionZh: 实质性交换；减轻但不完全废除惩罚、义务或付款以换取重大的、单一的事物或总体；兑现；减少
flashcards.exampleZh: 将什一税转换为一笔租金；以溢价换算市场租金，以季票换算每日票价

flashcards.definition: To remain over; remain untouched, unimpaired, unsettled, uncollected, unpaid, or otherwise undetermined.
flashcards.example: outstanding contracts
flashcards.definitionZh: 留下来；保持原状、未受损、未结算、未领取、未付款或以其他方式未确定。
flashcards.exampleZh: 未完成的合同

flashcards.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.
flashcards.example: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较远的地方移动到较近的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她来时，她会绕山而来[...]

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: The act of recovering data or a system from a backup.
flashcards.example: We backed up the data successfully, but the restore failed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从备份中恢复数据或系统的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们备份数据成功，但是恢复失败。

flashcards.definition: A spoken test or examination, particularly in a language class.
flashcards.example: We've got our Spanish oral tomorrow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 口语测试或考试，特别是在语言课上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 明天我们有西班牙语口语。

flashcards.definition: Those conditions and practices that promote and preserve health.
flashcards.example: Hygiene is an important consideration in places where food is prepared.
flashcards.definitionZh: 那些促进和维护健康的条件和做法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在准备食物的地方，卫生是一个重要的考虑因素。

flashcards.definition: To become full.
flashcards.example: the bucket filled with rain;  the sails fill with wind
flashcards.definitionZh: 变得充实。
flashcards.exampleZh: 桶里装满了雨水；  风帆充满风

flashcards.definition: Tending to resist change or innovation.
flashcards.example: The curriculum committee at this university is extremely conservative.
flashcards.definitionZh: 倾向于抵制变革或创新。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这所大学的课程委员会非常保守。

flashcards.definition: To estimate how something will be in the future.
flashcards.example: to forecast a rise in prices
flashcards.definitionZh: 估计某事将来会怎样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 预测价格上涨

flashcards.definition: Pleasing, encouraging or approving.
flashcards.example: The candidate wearing the business suite made a favourable impression.
flashcards.definitionZh: 令人愉悦、鼓励或认可。
flashcards.exampleZh: 穿着商务套装的候选人给人留下了良好的印象。

flashcards.definition: (by extension) The smallest amount; a whit; a jot.
flashcards.example: I don't care a continental!
flashcards.definitionZh: （推而广之）最小数量；一点；一点点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不在乎大陆！

flashcards.definition: A systematic list of names, books, pictures etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word Catalogue.
flashcards.definitionZh: 姓名、书籍、图片等的系统列表。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是目录这个词。

flashcards.definition: The first public presentation of a theatrical play, motion picture, opera, musical composition, dance, or other performing arts piece.
flashcards.example: Since making its debut two years ago, the program has gained cult status.
flashcards.definitionZh: 戏剧、电影、歌剧、音乐作品、舞蹈或其他表演艺术作品的首次公开演出。
flashcards.exampleZh: 自两年前首次亮相以来，该节目已获得了狂热的关注。

flashcards.definition: An enclosed underground space, often under a building, used for storage or shelter.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cellar.
flashcards.definitionZh: 封闭的地下空间，通常位于建筑物下方，用于储藏或遮蔽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“地窖”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Not belonging to the same country, land, or government, or to the citizens or subjects thereof; foreign.
flashcards.example: alien subjects, enemies, property, or shores
flashcards.definitionZh: 不属于同一国家、土地或政府，或其公民或臣民；外国的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 外来主体、敌人、财产或海岸

flashcards.definition: The Atlantic Ocean. Especially in across the pond.
flashcards.example: I haven't been back home across the pond in twenty years.
flashcards.definitionZh: 大西洋。尤其是在池塘对面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经二十年没有回过池塘对面的家了。

flashcards.definition: Specifically, a building material created by mixing cement, water, and aggregate such as gravel and sand.
flashcards.example: The road was made of concrete that had been poured in large slabs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具体来说，是通过混合水泥、水和砾石和沙子等骨料制成的建筑材料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这条路是用大块混凝土浇筑而成的。

flashcards.definition: Any agent acting to eliminate, reduce, mask, or control odor.
flashcards.example: This is the word Deodorant.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何能够消除、减少、掩盖或控制气味的物质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是除臭剂这个词。

flashcards.definition: A current fashion or fad.
flashcards.example: Miniskirts were all the rage back then.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当前的时尚或时尚。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那时迷你裙风靡一时。

flashcards.definition: An organized procession consisting of a series of consecutive displays, performances, exhibits, etc. displayed by moving down a street past a crowd of spectators.
flashcards.example: The floats and horses in the parade were impressive, but the marching bands were really amazing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有组织的游行，由一系列连续的展示、表演、展览等组成，沿着街道经过一群观众。
flashcards.exampleZh: 游行中的花车和马匹令人印象深刻，但游行乐队确实令人惊叹。

flashcards.definition: Of fruit or vegetables, to gain bruises through being handled roughly.
flashcards.example: Bananas bruise easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 水果或蔬菜，因粗暴处理而造成瘀伤。
flashcards.exampleZh: 香蕉很容易碰伤。

flashcards.definition: A relatively rare or difficult accomplishment.
flashcards.example: This is the word Feat.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相对罕见或困难的成就。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是壮举这个词。

flashcards.definition: The gray wolf, specifically all subspecies of the gray wolf (Canis lupus) that are not dingoes or dogs.
flashcards.example: Check out my pet. He's a wolf.
flashcards.definitionZh: 灰狼，特别是除野狗或狗以外的灰狼（Canis lupus）的所有亚种。
flashcards.exampleZh: 看看我的宠物。他是一头狼。

flashcards.definition: A young child who has started walking but not fully mastered it, typically between one and three years old.
flashcards.example: This is the word Toddler.
flashcards.definitionZh: 已经开始走路但尚未完全掌握的幼儿，通常在一岁到三岁之间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是幼儿这个词。

flashcards.definition: A living thing that is eaten by another living thing.
flashcards.example: The rabbit was eaten by the coyote, so the rabbit is the coyote's prey.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种生物被另一种生物吃掉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 兔子被郊狼吃掉了，所以兔子是郊狼的猎物。

flashcards.definition: The ratio of one quantity, representing something of interest, to another quantity representing space, area, or extent in which the thing of interest is distributed.
flashcards.example: The number of particles per unit volume of a specified volume can be considered to be the particle density for the specified volume.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示感兴趣的事物的一个量与表示感兴趣的事物分布的空间、面积或范围的另一个量的比率。
flashcards.exampleZh: 指定体积的每单位体积的颗粒数可以被认为是指定体积的颗粒密度。

flashcards.definition: A contract to sell a security at a set price on or before a certain date.
flashcards.example: He bought a January '08 put for Procter and Gamble at 80 to hedge his bet.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在特定日期或之前以设定价格出售证券的合同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以 80 美元的价格买入了宝洁公司 08 年 1 月的看跌期权来对冲他的赌注。

flashcards.definition: Over the edge; especially, off or outside of a boat.
flashcards.example: It was their practice to throw the scraps overboard.
flashcards.definitionZh: 越过边缘；尤其是在船外或船外。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们的做法是把残渣扔到船外。

flashcards.definition: The abdomen of a person, especially one that is enlarged
flashcards.example: beer gut
flashcards.definitionZh: 人的腹部，尤其是增大的腹部
flashcards.exampleZh: 啤酒肚

flashcards.definition: A procedure involving major incisions to remove, repair, or replace a part of a body.
flashcards.example: Many times surgery is necessary to prevent cancer from spreading.
flashcards.definitionZh: 涉及大切口以切除、修复或更换身体一部分的手术。
flashcards.exampleZh: 很多时候需要手术来防止癌症扩散。

flashcards.definition: To experience; to pass through a phase.
flashcards.example: The project is undergoing great changes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 去体验；去经历一个阶段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该项目正在发生巨大变化。

flashcards.definition: An exhibition of items.
flashcards.example: art show;  dog show
flashcards.definitionZh: 物品展览。
flashcards.exampleZh: 艺术展；  狗展

flashcards.definition: The rubbing of one object or surface against another.
flashcards.example: This is the word Friction.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个物体或表面与另一个物体或表面的摩擦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是摩擦力这个词。

flashcards.definition: A committal to something derogatory or objectionable; a prejudicial concession; a surrender.
flashcards.example: a compromise of character or right
flashcards.definitionZh: 对贬义或令人反感的事物的承诺；有偏见的让步；投降。
flashcards.exampleZh: 品格或权利的妥协

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: An act of stretching.
flashcards.example: I was right in the middle of a stretch when the phone rang.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种伸展的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 正当我正在伸懒腰的时候，电话响了。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: Any solid object rounded at one end and tapering on the other, possibly attached to a larger object at the tapered end.
flashcards.example: the bulb of the aorta
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何一端呈圆形、另一端呈锥形的固体物体，可能在锥形端附着在较大的物体上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 主动脉球部

flashcards.definition: An unsteady flash of light.
flashcards.example: the flicker of a poorly tuned television set
flashcards.definitionZh: 不稳定的闪光。
flashcards.exampleZh: 调谐不良的电视机的闪烁

flashcards.definition: The desire for some personal gratification, either of the body or of the mind.
flashcards.example: appetite for reading
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某些个人满足的渴望，无论是身体上还是心灵上的满足。
flashcards.exampleZh: 读书的欲望

flashcards.definition: Healthy.
flashcards.example: He was safe and sound.
flashcards.definitionZh: 健康。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他安然无恙。

flashcards.definition: The act of investing, or state of being invested.
flashcards.example: Giving your children a good education is a wise long-term investment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 投资行为或被投资状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为孩子提供良好的教育是一项明智的长期投资。
