flashcards.definition: To pay or reward someone in exchange for work done or some other consideration.
flashcards.example: It is hard work, but they will compensate you well for it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 支付或奖励某人以换取所做的工作或其他一些报酬。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然工作很辛苦，但他们会给你很好的补偿。

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: A cut of meat, often containing a section of a rib.
flashcards.example: I only like lamb chops with mint jelly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一块肉，通常含有一段肋骨。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我只喜欢薄荷果冻羊排。

flashcards.definition: Any roughly cylindrical (or rectangular) unit of a substance.
flashcards.example: Sealing wax is available as a cylindrical or rectangular stick.
flashcards.definitionZh: 物质的任何大致圆柱形（或矩形）单元。
flashcards.exampleZh: 密封蜡有圆柱形或矩形棒状。

flashcards.definition: To grip suddenly; to seize; to clutch.
flashcards.example: I grabbed her hand to pull her back from the cliff edge.
flashcards.definitionZh: 突然抓住；抓住；抓紧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我抓住她的手，将她从悬崖边拉了回来。

flashcards.definition: To move by hopping on alternate feet.
flashcards.example: She will skip from one end of the sidewalk to the other.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过交替脚跳跃来移动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她会从人行道的一端跳到另一端。

flashcards.definition: To prohibit movement or expression of.
flashcards.example: You're cramping my style.
flashcards.definitionZh: 禁止运动或表达。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你限制了我的风格。

flashcards.definition: To set apart or cut off from others.
flashcards.example: This is the word Isolated.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与他人分开或隔绝。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“孤立”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person from the countryside; a rustic.
flashcards.example: This is the word Rural.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个来自农村的人；质朴的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是农村这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of inhabiting; state of inhabiting or dwelling, or of being inhabited; occupancy.
flashcards.example: This is the word Habitation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 居住行为；居住或居住的状态，或被居住的状态；占用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“居所”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station.
flashcards.example: They agreed to meet at the bus stop.
flashcards.definitionZh: 公共汽车、有轨电车或火车停下来让乘客上下车的（通常有标记的）地方，通常比车站小。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们约定在公交车站见面。

flashcards.definition: A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station.
flashcards.example: They agreed to meet at the bus stop.
flashcards.definitionZh: 公共汽车、有轨电车或火车停下来让乘客上下车的（通常有标记的）地方，通常比车站小。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们约定在公交车站见面。

flashcards.definition: Term of address.
flashcards.example: This is the word Lively.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地址期限。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是热闹这个词。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: To arrange or settle something by mutual agreement.
flashcards.example: The client and server computers must first negotiate a network protocol to be used.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经双方同意安排或解决某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 客户端和服务器计算机必须首先协商要使用的网络协议。

flashcards.definition: The process of achieving agreement through discussion.
flashcards.example: This is the word Negotiation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过讨论达成一致的过程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是谈判这个词。

flashcards.definition: A clash or disagreement, often violent, between two or more opposing groups or individuals.
flashcards.example: The conflict between the government and the rebels began three years ago.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个或多个对立团体或个人之间的冲突或分歧，通常是暴力的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 政府与叛军之间的冲突始于三年前。

flashcards.definition: Not wanting to take some action; unwilling.
flashcards.example: She was reluctant to lend him the money
flashcards.definitionZh: 不想采取某些行动；不愿意。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她不愿意借钱给他

flashcards.definition: An act of being of assistance to someone.
flashcards.example: I say I did him a service by ending our relationship – now he can freely pursue his career.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向某人提供帮助的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我说我结束了我们的关系，帮了他一个忙——现在他可以自由地追求他的事业了。

flashcards.definition: A defensive position or effort.
flashcards.example: The Commander says we will make our stand here.
flashcards.definitionZh: 防守位置或努力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 指挥官说我们会坚守在这里。

flashcards.definition: Of, pertaining to, or having responsibility for the day-to-day running of an organisation, business, country, etc.
flashcards.example: an executive officer
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于、属于或负责组织、企业、国家等的日常运作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 执行官

flashcards.definition: A leader or head of a group of people, organisation, etc.
flashcards.example: All firefighters report to the fire chief.
flashcards.wordZh: 首席执行官 首席执行官
flashcards.definitionZh: 一群人、组织等的领导者或负责人
flashcards.exampleZh: 所有消防员均向消防队长报告。

flashcards.definition: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.
flashcards.example: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 退出、逃脱、缓刑等的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们制定了法律来给这些组织一个机会。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: To inhale a larger quantity of air than usual, and immediately expel it; to make a deep single audible respiration, especially as the result or involuntary expression of fatigue, exhaustion, grief, sorrow, frustration, or the like.
flashcards.example: He sighed over the lost opportunity.
flashcards.definitionZh: 吸入比平常更多的空气，并立即将其排出；发出一次深沉的、可听见的呼吸，尤其是由于疲劳、疲惫、悲伤、悲伤、沮丧等的结果或不自觉的表达。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他为失去的机会而叹息。

flashcards.definition: The brief terminal part of a vowel or vocal element, differing more or less in quality from the main part.
flashcards.example: a as in ale ordinarily ends with a vanish of i as in ill.
flashcards.definitionZh: 元音或声乐元素的简短结尾部分，在质量上与主要部分或多或少不同。
flashcards.exampleZh: ale 中的 a 通常以 ill 中的 i 消失而结束。

flashcards.definition: Of unknown origin.
flashcards.example: He received a mysterious phone call this morning.
flashcards.definitionZh: 来历不明。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天早上，他接到了一个神秘的电话。

flashcards.definition: Deserving of ridicule; foolish; absurd.
flashcards.example: It's ridiculous to charge so much for a little souvenir.
flashcards.definitionZh: 值得嘲笑；愚蠢的；荒诞。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为了一个小纪念品要花这么多钱，真是可笑。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: The crime of stealing or otherwise illegally obtaining money by use of deception tactics.
flashcards.example: This is the word Fraud.
flashcards.definitionZh: 采用欺骗手段盗窃或者以其他方式非法获取财物的犯罪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是欺诈一词。

flashcards.definition: To put together.
flashcards.example: He assembled the model ship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放在一起。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他组装了模型船。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: An item of clothing (usually worn by a woman or young girl) which both covers the upper part of the body and includes skirts below the waist.
flashcards.example: Amy and Mary looked very pretty in their dresses.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种衣服（通常由妇女或年轻女孩穿着），既覆盖上半身又包括腰部以下的裙子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 艾米和玛丽穿着衣服看起来非常漂亮。

flashcards.definition: An artist’s or photographer’s workshop or the room in which an artist works.
flashcards.example: His studio was cramped when he began as an artist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 艺术家或摄影师的工作室或艺术家工作的房间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他开始成为一名艺术家时，他的工作室很狭窄。

flashcards.definition: An artist’s or photographer’s workshop or the room in which an artist works.
flashcards.example: His studio was cramped when he began as an artist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 艺术家或摄影师的工作室或艺术家工作的房间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他开始成为一名艺术家时，他的工作室很狭窄。

flashcards.definition: A form of rented accommodation consisting of a single room for use as both sitting room and bedroom; there may also be a small kitchen area and washing and toilet facilities, but these amenities are more commonly outside the room and shared by several tenants.
flashcards.example: This is the word Bedsit.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种出租住宿形式，由一个单间组成，既用作起居室又用作卧室；可能还有一个小厨房区以及洗涤和卫生间设施，但这些设施更常见于房间外，并由多个租户共用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“Bedsit”这个词。

flashcards.definition: One who pays a fee (rent) in return for the use of land, buildings, or other property owned by others.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tenant.
flashcards.definitionZh: 支付费用（租金）以换取他人拥有的土地、建筑物或其他财产的使用的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是租客这个词。

flashcards.definition: Denoting a type of fever accompanying consumption and similar wasting diseases, characterised by flushed cheeks and dry skin.
flashcards.example: hectic fever
flashcards.definitionZh: 指一种伴随消耗性疾病和类似消耗性疾病的发烧，其特征是脸颊潮红和皮肤干燥。
flashcards.exampleZh: 潮热

flashcards.definition: Of high cost; expensive.

flashcards.exampleZh: 在凉爽的早晨

flashcards.definition: A moderate or refreshing state of cold; moderate temperature of the air between hot and cold; coolness.
flashcards.example: in the cool of the morning
flashcards.definitionZh: 中度或清爽的寒冷状态；空气温度介于冷热之间；凉爽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在凉爽的早晨

flashcards.definition: Not friendly, appropriate to an enemy; showing the disposition of an enemy; showing ill will and malevolence, or a desire to thwart and injure
flashcards.example: a hostile country
flashcards.definitionZh: 不友善，适合敌人；显示敌人的部署；表现出恶意和恶意，或想要阻止和伤害
flashcards.exampleZh: 敌对国家

flashcards.definition: The state of being hostile.
flashcards.example: My resentment and anger towards you caused hostility and a division between us.
flashcards.definitionZh: 敌对的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对你的怨恨和愤怒导致了我们之间的敌意和分裂。

flashcards.definition: To stop.
flashcards.example: And with that, his twitching ceased.
flashcards.definitionZh: 停下来。
flashcards.exampleZh: 就这样，他的抽搐停止了。

flashcards.definition: To go over, or jump over.
flashcards.example: He overed the fence in good style.
flashcards.definitionZh: 过去，或者跳过。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以良好的方式越过栅栏。

flashcards.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.
flashcards.example: Time stops for nobody.   the ebb and flow of time
flashcards.definitionZh: 随着现在和过去事件的过去，不可避免地走向未来。
flashcards.exampleZh: 时间为谁停止。   时间的潮起潮落

flashcards.definition: The part of Earth which is not covered by oceans or other bodies of water.
flashcards.example: Most insects live on land.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地球上未被海洋或其他水体覆盖的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大多数昆虫生活在陆地上。

flashcards.definition: To trip or fall; to walk clumsily.
flashcards.example: He stumbled over a rock.
flashcards.definitionZh: 绊倒或跌倒；笨拙地行走。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他被一块石头绊倒了。

flashcards.definition: An additional charge, especially for food in a restaurant.
flashcards.example: There is a £2 supplement if you choose the steak.
flashcards.definitionZh: 额外收费，尤其是在餐厅用餐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果选择牛排，需加收2英镑。

flashcards.definition: Any of a specific group of organic compounds essential in small quantities for healthy human growth, metabolism, development, and body function; found in minute amounts in plant and animal foods or sometimes produced synthetically; deficiencies of specific vitamins produce specific disorders.
flashcards.example: This is the word Vitamin.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何对人类健康生长、新陈代谢、发育和身体功能至关重要的少量特定有机化合物；存在于植物和动物食品中或有时合成生产的微量；特定维生素的缺乏会产生特定的疾病。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是维生素这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any naturally occurring inorganic material that has a (more or less) definite chemical composition and characteristic physical properties.
flashcards.example: This is the word Mineral.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何天然存在的无机材料，具有（或多或少）确定的化学成分和特征物理性质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是矿物这个词。

flashcards.definition: An act of tracing.
flashcards.example: Your cell phone company can put a trace on your line.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种追踪行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您的手机公司可以在您的线路上留下痕迹。

flashcards.definition: Broadly or completely covering; including a large proportion of something.
flashcards.example: When there are diametrically opposing views on a big issue that concerns millions of people, doing comprehensive research just makes sense.
flashcards.definitionZh: 广泛或完全覆盖；包括某物的很大一部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当对涉及数百万人的重大问题存在截然相反的观点时，进行全面的研究才有意义。

flashcards.definition: A shelf on which articles may be laid; also, that which resembles such a shelf in form or use, as a projecting ridge or part, or a molding or edge in joinery.
flashcards.example: This is the word Ledge.
flashcards.definitionZh: 可以放置物品的架子；此外，在形式或用途上类似于这种架子的东西，如突出的脊或部件，或者细木工中的模制件或边缘。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是壁架这个词。

flashcards.definition: To look at or repel with a scowl or a frown.
flashcards.example: to scowl a rival into submission
flashcards.definitionZh: 皱起眉头看着或排斥。
flashcards.exampleZh: 怒容对手屈服

flashcards.definition: A path through two or more points (compare ‘segment’); a continuous mark, including as made by a pen; any path, curved or straight.
flashcards.example: The arrow descended in a curved line.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过两个或多个点的路径（比较“线段”）；连续的标记，包括用钢笔做的标记；任何路径，无论是弯的还是直的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 箭矢呈曲线下降。

flashcards.definition: A title sometimes given to the servants of the sovereign.
flashcards.example: sergeant surgeon, i.e. a servant, or attendant, surgeon
flashcards.definitionZh: 有时授予君主仆人的头衔。
flashcards.exampleZh: 军士外科医生，即仆人或服务员、外科医生

flashcards.definition: The organic process by which an organism assimilates food and uses it for growth and maintenance.
flashcards.example: This is the word Nutrition.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有机体吸收食物并将其用于生长和维持的有机过程。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是营养这个词。

flashcards.definition: A source of nourishment, such as food, that can be metabolized by an organism to give energy and build tissue.
flashcards.example: This is the word Nutrient.
flashcards.definitionZh: 营养来源，例如食物，可以被生物体代谢以提供能量和构建组织。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是营养这个词。

flashcards.definition: A natural substance that is used to make the ground more suitable for growing plants.
flashcards.example: This is the word Fertilizer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种天然物质，用于使地面更适合植物生长。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是肥料这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of joining, or the state of being joined.
flashcards.example: This is the word Junction.
flashcards.definitionZh: 加入的行为，或加入的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“交界处”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (Australia and sometimes United States) A road junction at which traffic streams circularly around a central island.
flashcards.example: This is the word Roundabout.
flashcards.definitionZh: （澳大利亚，有时是美国）交通在中央岛屿周围循环流动的路口。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“Roundabout”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To negatively criticize.
flashcards.example: Quit harshing me already, I said that I was sorry!
flashcards.definitionZh: 进行负面批评。
flashcards.exampleZh: 别再骂我了，我已经说了对不起了！

flashcards.definition: Stunningly beautiful; amazing
flashcards.example: He went to the Grand Canyon and spent a week taking in the breathtaking scenery all around him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 美丽得令人惊叹；惊人的
flashcards.exampleZh: 他去了大峡谷，花了一周的时间欣赏周围令人惊叹的风景。

flashcards.definition: Nerve, gall.
flashcards.example: You've got a lot of crust standing there saying that.
flashcards.definitionZh: 神经，胆汁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有很多人站在那里这么说。

flashcards.definition: A conclusive success following an effort, conflict, or confrontation of obstacles; victory; conquest.
flashcards.example: the triumph of knowledge
flashcards.definitionZh: 经过努力、冲突或面对障碍后取得决定性的成功；胜利;征服。
flashcards.exampleZh: 知识的胜利

flashcards.definition: To clothe with authority, power, etc.; to put in possession; to invest; to furnish; to endow; followed by with and the thing conferred.
flashcards.example: to vest a court with power to try cases of life and death
flashcards.definitionZh: 拥有权威、权力等；占有；投资；提供；给予；接下来是 with 和 the thing grant。
flashcards.exampleZh: 赋予法院审理生死案件的权力

flashcards.definition: A hand with the fingers clenched or curled inward.
flashcards.example: The boxer's fists rained down on his opponent in the last round.
flashcards.definitionZh: 手指握紧或向内卷曲的手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 最后一轮拳击手的拳头如雨点般落在对手身上。

flashcards.definition: Plants, taken collectively.
flashcards.example: There were large amounts of vegetation in the forest.
flashcards.definitionZh: 植物，统称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 森林里有大量的植被。

flashcards.definition: A sum of money paid for instruction (such as in a high school, boarding school, university, or college).
flashcards.example: These rosemaling workshops are no place for anyone who wants to pester me or the students with the "white privilege" card, inter alia. Therefore, I reserve the right to refund the tuition of such men and women, kick them out the door, and bar them from at least two of my future events.
flashcards.definitionZh: 支付教学费用的一笔钱（例如在高中、寄宿学校、大学或学院）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些迷迭香工作坊不适合任何想用“白人特权”卡纠缠我或学生的人。因此，我保留退还这些人的学费、将他们赶出家门、并禁止他们参加我未来至少两次活动的权利。

flashcards.definition: One who solicits.
flashcards.example: This is the word Solicitor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位乞讨的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是律师这个词。

flashcards.definition: Plates, dishes and other eating and serving tableware, usually made of some ceramic material.
flashcards.example: This is the word Crockery.
flashcards.definitionZh: 盘子、盘子和其他饮食和服务餐具，通常由某种陶瓷材料制成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是陶器这个词。

flashcards.definition: A long, thin, flexible length of twisted yarns (strands) of fiber (rope, for example); (uncountable) such a length of twisted strands considered as a commodity.
flashcards.example: He looped some cord around his fingers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 长、细、柔韧的纤维加捻纱（股）（例如绳索）； （不可数）如此长度的绞合线被视为商品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他把一根绳子绕在手指上。

flashcards.definition: The act of forging metal into shape.
flashcards.example: the forgery of horseshoes
flashcards.definitionZh: 将金属锻造成形状的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马蹄铁的伪造

flashcards.definition: Powder or paste made from seeds of the mustard plant, and used as a condiment or a spice.
flashcards.example: When the waitress brought the food, I asked whether she had any Dijon mustard.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由芥菜种子制成的粉末或糊状物，用作调味品或香料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当女服务员送来食物时，我问她有没有第戎芥末。

flashcards.definition: Anything inconsequential or superficial.
flashcards.example: That article was basically a bunch of fluff. It didn't say anything substantive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何无关紧要或肤浅的事情。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那篇文章基本上是一堆废话。并没有说什么实质性的事情。

flashcards.definition: A defined, narrow section of land or an artificial structure used for access.
flashcards.example: This is the word Runway.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于通道的界定的狭窄土地或人工结构。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是跑道这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person skilled at carpentry, the trade of cutting and joining timber in order to construct buildings or other structures.
flashcards.example: This is the word Carpenter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 木工技术熟练的人员，木工是切割和连接木材以建造建筑物或其他结构的行业。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是木匠这个词。

flashcards.definition: A feeling of fear and reverence.
flashcards.example: This is the word Awe.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种恐惧和敬畏的感觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是敬畏这个词。

flashcards.definition: Mutual; shared by more than one.
flashcards.example: The two competitors have the common aim of winning the championship.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相互的;被多个人共享。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两位选手有着共同的目标，那就是夺得冠军。

flashcards.definition: A quiet or unintelligible vocalization; a low tone of voice.
flashcards.example: All I could hear was a mumble from the next room.
flashcards.definitionZh: 安静或难以理解的发声；低沉的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我只能听到隔壁房间传来的咕哝声。

flashcards.definition: A repressed or obscure utterance; an instance of muttering.
flashcards.example: The prisoners were docile, and accepted their lot with barely a mutter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 压抑或晦涩的话语；嘟囔的一个例子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 囚犯们都很温顺，几乎没有嘀咕一声就接受了自己的命运。

flashcards.definition: A place at which one is regularly found; a habitation or hangout.
flashcards.example: I went back the town I used to live and visited all my old haunts.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经常出现的地方；居住地或聚会场所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我回到了我曾经住过的小镇，参观了所有我常去的地方。

flashcards.definition: To frighten greatly; to fill with terror.
flashcards.example: This is the word Terrify.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使受到极大的惊吓；充满恐惧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是恐怖这个词。

flashcards.definition: To stay or remain in a place or situation, especially as if unwilling to depart or not easily able to do so; to loiter.
flashcards.example: This is the word Linger.
flashcards.definitionZh: 停留或留在某个地方或情况，尤其是好像不愿意离开或不容易离开；闲逛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是灵儿这个词。

flashcards.definition: The specific taste or smell of something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Savour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的特定味道或气味。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“品味”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Having the power to produce a required effect or effects.
flashcards.example: The pill is an effective method of birth control.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有产生所需效果的能力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 避孕药是一种有效的避孕方法。

flashcards.definition: To close shutters covering.
flashcards.example: Shutter the windows: there's a storm coming!
flashcards.definitionZh: 关闭百叶窗覆盖物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 关上窗户：暴风雨即将来临！

flashcards.definition: Tending to permit, allow, understand, or accept something
flashcards.example: He's pretty tolerant of different political views, but don't ask him about religion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 倾向于允许、允许、理解或接受某事
flashcards.exampleZh: 他对不同的政治观点相当宽容，但不要问他有关宗教的问题。

flashcards.definition: Any state of disorder; a confused or amorphous mixture or conglomeration.
flashcards.example: After the earthquake, the local hospital was in chaos
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何紊乱状态；混乱的或无定形的混合物或聚集体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地震发生后，当地医院一片混乱

flashcards.definition: An agreement or contract.
flashcards.example: This is the word Compact.
flashcards.definitionZh: 协议或合同。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“紧凑”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Having plenty of space; roomy.
flashcards.example: The apartment has a spacious bedroom.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有足够的空间；宽敞。
flashcards.exampleZh: 公寓设有宽敞的卧室。

flashcards.definition: A knapsack, sometimes mounted on a light frame, but always supported by straps, worn on a person’s back for the purpose of carrying things, especially when hiking, or on a student's back when carrying books.
flashcards.example: This is the word Backpack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种背包，有时安装在轻型框架上，但总是由带子支撑，背在人的背上，用于携带物品，特别是在徒步旅行时，或者在学生背书时背在背上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是背包这个词。

flashcards.definition: A bag carried on the back or shoulder, supported by straps
flashcards.example: This is the word Rucksack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 背在背上或肩上的包，由带子支撑
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“背包”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A building, wing or dependency set apart and adapted for lodging and feeding (and training) animals with hoofs, especially horses.
flashcards.example: There were stalls for fourteen horses in the squire's stables.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为住宿和喂养（和训练）有蹄动物（尤其是马）而分开的建筑物、翼楼或附属物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 乡绅的马厩里有十四匹马的马厩。

flashcards.definition: The chance of suffering harm; danger, peril, risk of loss.
flashcards.example: He encountered the enemy at the hazard of his reputation and life.
flashcards.definitionZh: 遭受伤害的机会；危险，危险，损失的风险。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他冒着名誉和生命危险遭遇敌人。

flashcards.definition: A light, gentle wind.
flashcards.example: The breeze rustled the papers on her desk.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一阵轻柔的风。
flashcards.exampleZh: 微风吹得她桌上的文件沙沙作响。

flashcards.definition: The quantity of liquid (such as water, alcohol, or medicine) drunk in one swallow.
flashcards.example: She took a deep draft from the bottle of water.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次吞下的液体（例如水、酒精或药物）的量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她从瓶子里深深地喝了一口水。

flashcards.definition: Determination; will power.
flashcards.example: It took all my resolve to go through with the surgery.
flashcards.definitionZh: 决心;意志力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我用尽了全部的决心才完成了手术。

flashcards.definition: A sincere attempt; a determined or assiduous effort towards a specific goal; assiduous or persistent activity.
flashcards.example: This is the word Endeavour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 真诚的尝试；为实现特定目标而坚定或不懈的努力；勤奋或持续的活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是努力这个词。

flashcards.definition: (British slang) A jot, in the phrase 'give a toss'.
flashcards.example: I couldn't give a toss about her.
flashcards.definitionZh: （英国俚语）短语“give a toss”中的一个记号。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对她无能为力。

flashcards.definition: By it; by that; by that means, or as a consequence of that.
flashcards.example: This is the word Thereby.
flashcards.definitionZh: 靠它；以此；通过这种方式，或者作为这种方式的结果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“因此”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An anthropomorphic representation of a skeleton.
flashcards.example: She dressed up as a skeleton for Halloween.
flashcards.definitionZh: 骨骼的拟人化表现。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她在万圣节打扮成骷髅。

flashcards.definition: A mark or token of approbation or to recognize excellence.
flashcards.example: For her good performance in the examination, her teacher gave her ten merits.
flashcards.definitionZh: 认可或认可卓越的标志或象征。
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于她在考试中表现出色，老师给了她十个优点。

flashcards.definition: Careless, without appropriate or sufficient attention.
flashcards.example: This is the word Negligent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 粗心，没有适当或足够的注意。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是疏忽这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person, group, or state (etc) which is associated with another for a common cause; one united to another by treaty or common purpose; a confederate.
flashcards.example: the two countries were allies in WWI
flashcards.definitionZh: 因共同事业而与他人有联系的个人、团体或国家（等）；一国通过条约或共同目标而与另一国联合；一个同盟者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两国在第一次世界大战中是盟友

flashcards.definition: Along the side; by the side; side by side with.
flashcards.example: Ahoy! Bring your boat alongside mine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 沿着侧面；在旁边；并肩与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 哎哟！把你的船带到我的旁边。

flashcards.definition: A place where waste or garbage is left; a ground or place for dumping ashes, refuse, etc.; a disposal site.
flashcards.example: A toxic waste dump.
flashcards.definitionZh: 留下废物或垃圾的地方；倾倒骨灰、垃圾等的场地或场所；一个处置场。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有毒废物倾倒场。

flashcards.definition: To cohere or stick together in a mass.
flashcards.example: Just to make the cheese more binding
flashcards.definitionZh: 凝聚或粘在一起形成一团。
flashcards.exampleZh: 只是为了让奶酪更有粘合力

flashcards.definition: With infinitive object: to be so presumptuous as (to do something) without proper authority or permission.
flashcards.example: I wouldn't presume to tell him how to do his job.
flashcards.definitionZh: 带不定式宾语：未经适当的授权或许可就冒昧地（做某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不会冒昧地告诉他如何做他的工作。

flashcards.definition: A number representing the position of a point along a line, arc, or similar one-dimensional figure.
flashcards.example: Give me your coordinates and we'll come and rescue you.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表示点沿直线、圆弧或类似一维图形的位置的数字。
flashcards.exampleZh: 告诉我你的坐标，我们会来救你。

flashcards.definition: A wooden band or yoke put around the neck of an ox or cow in the stall.
flashcards.example: This is the word Sole.
flashcards.definitionZh: 牛栏里套在牛脖子上的木带或轭。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是鞋底这个词。

flashcards.definition: A body that administers; the executive part of government; the persons collectively who are entrusted with the execution of laws and the superintendence of public affairs; the chief magistrate and his cabinet or council; or the council, or ministry, alone, as in Great Britain.
flashcards.example: Successive US administrations have had similar Middle East policies.
flashcards.definitionZh: A body that administers;政府的行政部门；受委托执行法律和监督公共事务的人员的集体；首席法官及其内阁或理事会；或单独的理事会或部委，就像在英国一样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 历届美国政府都有类似的中东政策。

flashcards.definition: Awkward, lacking coordination, not graceful, not dextrous.
flashcards.example: He's very clumsy. I wouldn't trust him with carrying the dishes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 笨拙、缺乏协调、不优雅、不灵巧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他非常笨拙。我不相信他会端盘子。

flashcards.definition: Help; assistance; succor, relief.
flashcards.example: He came to my aid when I was foundering.
flashcards.definitionZh: 帮助;协助;救助，救济。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我陷入困境时，他来帮助我。

flashcards.definition: (by extension) Abounding in goods or riches; having a moderate level of material wealth.
flashcards.example: They were affluent, but aspired to true wealth.
flashcards.definitionZh: （引申为）货物或财富丰富；具有中等水平的物质财富。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们很富裕，但渴望真正的财富。

flashcards.definition: To ooze or pass slowly through pores or other small openings, and in overly small quantities; said of liquids, etc.
flashcards.example: The water steadily seeped in through the thirl.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过毛孔或其他小开口缓慢渗出或通过，且数量过少；说的是液体等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 水不断地从水滴里渗进来。

flashcards.definition: The usual amount swallowed.
flashcards.example: This is the word Gulp.
flashcards.definitionZh: 正常吞咽量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“咕噜”这个词。

flashcards.definition: All animals or plants of the same species or subspecies.
flashcards.example: a breed of animal
flashcards.definitionZh: 同一物种或亚种的所有动物或植物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一种动物

flashcards.definition: To import or export, illicitly or by stealth, without paying lawful customs charges or duties
flashcards.example: This is the word Smuggle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非法或秘密进口或出口，而不支付合法的海关费用或关税
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是走私这个词。

flashcards.definition: A substance used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.
flashcards.example: Aspirin is a drug that reduces pain, acts against inflammation and lowers body temperature.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出于特定目的用于治疗疾病、缓解症状或改变体内化学过程的物质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 阿司匹林是一种减轻疼痛、抗炎和降低体温的药物。

flashcards.definition: A powerful and addictive drug derived from opium producing intense euphoria classed as an illegal narcotic in most of the world.
flashcards.example: This is the word Heroin.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种从鸦片中提取的强效致瘾药物，能产生强烈的欣快感，在世界大部分地区被列为非法麻醉品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是海洛因这个词。

flashcards.definition: A stimulant narcotic, derived from cultivated plants of the genus Erythroxylum, in the form of a white powder that users generally self-administer by insufflation through the nose.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cocaine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种兴奋性麻醉剂，源自赤木属栽培植物，呈白色粉末状，使用者通常通过鼻子吹入自行给药。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是可卡因这个词。

flashcards.definition: True, real, actual.
flashcards.example: He tried his very best.
flashcards.definitionZh: 真实、真实、实在。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他尽了最大努力。

flashcards.definition: A particularly special or compatible person or thing.
flashcards.example: I knew as soon I met him that John was the one for me and we were married within a month.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特别特别或兼容的人或事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我一见到他就知道约翰是我的最爱，我们在一个月内就结婚了。

flashcards.definition: A particularly special or compatible person or thing.
flashcards.example: I knew as soon I met him that John was the one for me and we were married within a month.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特别特别或兼容的人或事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我一见到他就知道约翰是我的最爱，我们在一个月内就结婚了。

flashcards.definition: The style of writing of a person.
flashcards.example: I can't read your writing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的写作风格。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我读不懂你的文字。

flashcards.definition: A newspaper or magazine dealing with a particular subject.
flashcards.example: The university's biology department subscribes to half a dozen academic journals.
flashcards.definitionZh: 涉及特定主题的报纸或杂志。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该大学的生物系订阅了六种学术期刊。

flashcards.definition: An individual post to a blog.
flashcards.example: This blog was originally posted on my personal site but is reproduced on the forums for greater visibility.
flashcards.definitionZh: 博客上的个人帖子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该博客最初发布在我的个人网站上，但为了提高知名度而在论坛上转载。

flashcards.definition: Pertaining to or consisting of objective claims.
flashcards.example: This is the word Factual.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与客观主张有关或由客观主张组成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“事实”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Visually attractive
flashcards.example: This is the word Eye-catching.
flashcards.definitionZh: 视觉上有吸引力
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“引人注目”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A manner in which a problem is solved or policy is made.
flashcards.example: 1991, Carol Lee Johnston, Jeanne Lazaris, Plane Trigonometry, A New Approach.
flashcards.definitionZh: 解决问题或制定政策的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1991 年，卡罗尔·李·约翰斯顿、珍妮·拉扎里斯，平面三角学，一种新方法。

flashcards.definition: Carried out using a planned, ordered procedure.
flashcards.example: This is the word Systematic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用有计划、有序的程序进行。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是系统化这个词。

flashcards.definition: A party, celebration, social function.
flashcards.example: We’re having a bit of a do on Saturday to celebrate my birthday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚会、庆典、社交活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 周六我们会做一些事情来庆祝我的生日。

flashcards.definition: To interact with others
flashcards.example: This is the word Socialize.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与他人互动
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是社交这个词。

flashcards.definition: The food or money required to keep someone alive and healthy; one's support, maintenance.
flashcards.example: He works as a cobbler's apprentice for his keep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 维持某人生存和健康所需的食物或金钱；一个人的支持、维护。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他当补鞋匠的学徒以维持生计。

flashcards.definition: (with from) To get off or exit a vehicle or animal; to descend; to dismount.
flashcards.example: He alighted from his horse.
flashcards.definitionZh: （与 from）下车或离开车辆或动物；下降；下马。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他下了马。

flashcards.definition: An instance of this chemical reaction, especially when intentionally created and maintained in a specific location to a useful end (such as a campfire or a hearth fire).
flashcards.example: We sat about the fire singing songs and telling tales.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这种化学反应的一个实例，特别是当故意在特定位置产生并维持以达到有用目的时（例如篝火或炉火）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们坐在火边唱歌、讲故事。

flashcards.definition: To face or deal with, attempting to overcome or fight down.
flashcards.example: The government's measures to tackle crime were insufficient.
flashcards.definitionZh: 面对或处理，试图克服或击倒。
flashcards.exampleZh: 政府打击犯罪的措施还不够。

flashcards.definition: A severe, formal or official reproof; reprehension, rebuke, private or public.
flashcards.example: This is the word Reprimand.
flashcards.definitionZh: 严厉的、正式的或官方的责备；私下或公开的谴责、斥责。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是斥责这个词。

flashcards.definition: Recourse, refuge (something or someone turned to for safety).
flashcards.example: to have resort to violence
flashcards.definitionZh: 求助、避难所（为了安全而求助于某事或某人）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 诉诸暴​​力

flashcards.definition: To be able to see beforehand: to anticipate; predict.
flashcards.example: This is the word Foresee.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能够预见：预料到；预测。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是预见这个词。

flashcards.definition: A public event where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.
flashcards.example: This is the word Auction.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将货物或财产出售给出价最高者的公共活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是拍卖这个词。

flashcards.definition: To issue a command; to tell.
flashcards.example: He bade me come in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发出命令；告诉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他请我进来。

flashcards.definition: Excessive; going beyond that what is natural or sufficient.
flashcards.example: To individuals who despise killings in any form, death penalty is undue punishment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 过多的;超越自然或充分的范围。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对于鄙视任何形式杀戮的人来说，死刑都是不适当的惩罚。

flashcards.definition: To move rapidly, violently, or without control.
flashcards.example: Pieces of broken glass hurtled through the air.
flashcards.definitionZh: 快速、猛烈或不受控制地移动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 破碎的玻璃碎片在空中飞舞。

flashcards.definition: Step.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pace.
flashcards.definitionZh: 步。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是佩斯这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any domestic animal that has no enclosure, or its proper place and company, and wanders at large, or is lost; an estray.
flashcards.example: This is the word Stray.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何家畜没有围栏、没有适当的场所和陪伴、四处游荡或迷路的；一次流浪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是流浪这个词。

flashcards.definition: A small pool of water, usually on a path or road.
flashcards.example: This is the word Puddle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个小水池，通常位于小路或道路上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是水坑这个词。

flashcards.definition: Soaked with moisture or other liquid.
flashcards.example: This is the word Soggy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被水分或其他液体浸泡。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“湿透”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To halt, stop, eliminate, stamp out, or put down, often suddenly or by force
flashcards.example: Even the king’s announcement could not squelch the rumors.
flashcards.definitionZh: 停止、制止、消除、消灭或镇压，通常是突然地或用武力
flashcards.exampleZh: 即使国王的声明也无法平息谣言。

flashcards.definition: To move suddenly, or be excited, on feeling alarm; to start.
flashcards.example: a horse that startles easily
flashcards.definitionZh: 感到惊慌时突然移动或兴奋；开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一匹容易受惊的马

flashcards.definition: The beginning of an activity.
flashcards.example: The movie was entertaining from start to finish.
flashcards.definitionZh: 活动的开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这部电影从头到尾都很有趣。

flashcards.definition: To take in energy and convert it, as
flashcards.example: Heat, light, and electricity are absorbed in the substances into which they pass.
flashcards.definitionZh: 吸收能量并将其转化为
flashcards.exampleZh: 热、光和电被它们所进入的物质吸收。

flashcards.definition: A wish or urge, particularly a sudden one prompting action.
flashcards.example: The impulse to learn drove me to study night and day.
flashcards.definitionZh: 愿望或冲动，尤其是突然的促使采取行动的愿望或冲动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 学习的冲动驱使我夜以继日地学习。

flashcards.definition: An act of thinking; consideration (of something).
flashcards.example: I'll have a think about that and let you know.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种思考的行为；考虑（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我会考虑一下并告诉你。

flashcards.definition: An undefined, unknown or unimportant person; a person of no consequence.
flashcards.example: The party was boring. It was full of randoms.
flashcards.definitionZh: 未定义、未知或不重要的人；一个无足轻重的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 聚会很无聊。它充满了随机性。

flashcards.definition: To take up or introduce (something) prematurely.
flashcards.example: The advocate plans to anticipate a part of her argument.
flashcards.definitionZh: 过早地接受或介绍（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 辩护人计划预测她的论点的一部分。

flashcards.definition: The condition of being prosperous, of having good fortune
flashcards.example: This is the word Prosperity.
flashcards.definitionZh: 繁荣、有好运的条件
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是繁荣这个词。

flashcards.definition: Characterized by success
flashcards.example: Trading Babe Ruth was far more prosperous for the Yankees than for the Red Sox.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以成功为特征
flashcards.exampleZh: 交易贝比·鲁斯对洋基队来说比对红袜队来说要繁荣得多。

flashcards.definition: A male animal, especially a stud horse (stallion), kept for breeding.
flashcards.example: This is the word Stud.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种雄性动物，尤其是种马（种马），为繁殖而饲养。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是梭哈这个词。

flashcards.definition: A light, short sleep or nap.
flashcards.example: I felt much better after a short doze.
flashcards.definitionZh: 浅睡眠或短睡眠。
flashcards.exampleZh: 短暂的瞌睡后我感觉好多了。

flashcards.definition: A light, short sleep or nap.
flashcards.example: I felt much better after a short doze.
flashcards.definitionZh: 浅睡眠或短睡眠。
flashcards.exampleZh: 短暂的瞌睡后我感觉好多了。

flashcards.definition: (now uncommon or literary) To wish, desire (something).
flashcards.example: Do what you will.
flashcards.definitionZh: （现在不常见或文学）希望，渴望（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 做你想做的事。

flashcards.definition: A location or restaurant where good eating can be expected.
flashcards.example: Sally is having a breakfast munch at her place!
flashcards.definitionZh: 可以期待美食的地点或餐厅。
flashcards.exampleZh: 莎莉正在她家吃早餐！

flashcards.definition: To eat with small, quick bites.
flashcards.example: The rabbit nibbled at the lettuce.
flashcards.definitionZh: 吃得小而快。
flashcards.exampleZh: 兔子啃着生菜。

flashcards.definition: (jewelry) Previously owned; secondhand.
flashcards.example: an estate diamond; estate jewelry
flashcards.definitionZh: （珠宝）以前拥有的；二手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 遗产钻石；地产珠宝

flashcards.definition: To bundle third-party dependencies with the source code for one's own program.
flashcards.example: I distributed my application with a vendored copy of Perl so that it wouldn't use the system copies of Perl where it is installed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将第三方依赖项与自己的程序的源代码捆绑在一起。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我使用 Perl 的供应商副本分发了我的应用程序，这样它就不会使用安装它的 Perl 系统副本。

flashcards.definition: Absent in mind; often preoccupied; forgetful or careless due to distraction; easily distracted.
flashcards.example: It took the absent-minded man twenty minutes to find his glasses on top of his head.
flashcards.definitionZh: 心不在焉；经常心事重重；因分心而健忘或粗心；容易分心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 心不在焉的男人花了二十分钟才发现自己的眼镜在他的头顶上。

flashcards.definition: Having restricted or rigid views, and being unreceptive to new ideas.
flashcards.example: This is the word Narrow-minded.
flashcards.definitionZh: 观点有限或僵化，不接受新想法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是狭隘这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of similar opinion, given to holding similar opinions.
flashcards.example: The like-minded politicians voted the same way so often they were thought of as one person rather than two.
flashcards.definitionZh: 持相似意见，给予持有相似意见。
flashcards.exampleZh: 志同道合的政治家经常以同样的方式投票，因此他们被认为是一个人而不是两个人。

flashcards.definition: A large or dense piece of something.
flashcards.example: a hunk of metal
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的大块或致密块。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一块金属

flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: That can be eaten without harm; innocuous to humans; suitable for consumption.
flashcards.example: edible fruit
flashcards.definitionZh: 可以吃而无害；对人类无害；适合食用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 食用水果

flashcards.definition: Capable or being adapted or molded in some way.
flashcards.example: This was a principle more flexible to their purpose. -Rogers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 能够以某种方式进行调整或塑造。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是一个对于他们的目的来说更灵活的原则。 -罗杰斯。

flashcards.definition: Characterised by minimalism and intuitiveness while preserving exactness and precision.
flashcards.example: an elegant solution
flashcards.definitionZh: 其特点是极简主义和直观性，同时保持准确性和精确性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个优雅的解决方案

flashcards.definition: Having a soothing effect; not irritating or stimulating.
flashcards.example: a bland diet
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有舒缓作用；不刺激或刺激。
flashcards.exampleZh: 清淡的饮食

flashcards.definition: A line of latitude.
flashcards.example: The 31st parallel passes through the center of my town.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一条纬线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 北纬 31 度线穿过我镇中心。

flashcards.definition: Large; great in size, extent, capacity, or bulk; for example spacious, roomy or widely extended.
flashcards.example: an ample house
flashcards.definitionZh: 大的;尺寸、范围、容量或体积大；例如宽敞、宽敞或宽阔。
flashcards.exampleZh: 宽敞的房子

flashcards.definition: (of land etc) capable of growing abundant crops; productive
flashcards.example: This is the word Fertile.
flashcards.definitionZh: （土地等）能够种植丰富的农作物；富有成效的
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是肥沃这个词。

flashcards.definition: Of or pertaining to sensation.
flashcards.example: sensational nerves
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于或关于感觉的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 感觉神经

flashcards.definition: Concerning the relationships between the governments of countries.
flashcards.example: Albania immediately severed diplomatic relations with Zimbabwe.
flashcards.definitionZh: 关于各国政府之间的关系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 阿尔巴尼亚立即与津巴布韦断绝外交关系。

flashcards.definition: Evil or seemingly evil; indicating lurking danger or harm.
flashcards.example: sinister influences
flashcards.definitionZh: 邪恶的或看似邪恶的；表明潜在的危险或伤害。
flashcards.exampleZh: 险恶的影响

flashcards.definition: Extinguished, no longer alight (of fire, candles etc.)
flashcards.example: Poor Edward's cigarillo was already extinct.
flashcards.definitionZh: 熄灭，不再点燃（火、蜡烛等）
flashcards.exampleZh: 可怜的爱德华的小雪茄已经绝迹了。

flashcards.definition: To place bias upon; to influence.
flashcards.example: Our prejudices bias our views.
flashcards.definitionZh: 施加偏见；影响。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的偏见会影响我们的观点。

flashcards.definition: Dismal and gloomy, cold and forbidding
flashcards.example: Life was grim in many northern industrial towns.
flashcards.definitionZh: 阴郁、阴郁、寒冷、令人生畏
flashcards.exampleZh: 许多北方工业城镇的生活十分严峻。

flashcards.definition: Solitary confinement.
flashcards.example: The prisoners who started the riot were moved to solitary.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单独监禁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 引发骚乱的囚犯被转移到单独监禁的地方。

flashcards.definition: Bare, not covered by clothing.
flashcards.example: She was as naked as the day she was born.
flashcards.definitionZh: 赤身露体，没有衣服遮盖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她就像出生那天一样赤身裸体。

flashcards.definition: Negates the meaning of the modified verb.
flashcards.example: Did you take out the trash? No, I did not.
flashcards.definitionZh: 否定被修饰动词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你倒垃圾了吗？不，我没有。

flashcards.definition: No particular place, noplace.
flashcards.example: They went on a cruise to nowhere.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有特别的地方，没有地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们乘船航行，不知去向。

flashcards.definition: A nobody (insignificant person).
flashcards.example: You're nothing to me now!
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个无名小卒（无足轻重的人）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 现在你对我来说什么都不是了！

flashcards.definition: (usually in the passive) To join, unite; to form links between (now especially of two places in different countries).
flashcards.example: Coventry twinned with Dresden as an act of peace and reconciliation, both cities having been heavily bombed during the war.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为被动语态）加入，团结；在（现在特别是不同国家的两个地方）之间建立联系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 作为和平与和解的举措，考文垂与德累斯顿结为友好城市，这两个城市在战争期间都遭到了严重轰炸。

flashcards.definition: To leave high and dry on shore.
flashcards.example: to sue a ship
flashcards.definitionZh: 留在岸上高处和干燥处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 起诉一艘船

flashcards.definition: A person following the pursuits of civil life, especially one who is not an active member of the armed forces.
flashcards.example: Three civilians were apprehended by the soldiers and taken away in a military vehicle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 追求公民生活的人，尤其是不是武装部队现役成员的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 三名平民被士兵逮捕并用军车带走。

flashcards.definition: Having to do with people and government office as opposed to the military or religion.
flashcards.example: She went into civil service because she wanted to help the people.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与人民和政府办公室有关，而不是与军队或宗教有关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她进入公务员队伍是因为她想帮助人民。

flashcards.definition: Strength or energy of body or mind; active power; vigour; might; capacity of exercising an influence or producing an effect.
flashcards.example: the force of an appeal, an argument, or a contract
flashcards.definitionZh: 身体或精神的力量或能量；有功功率；活力;可能;施加影响或产生效果的能力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 上诉、争论或合同的效力

flashcards.definition: To give one's time, focus one's efforts, commit oneself, etc. entirely for, on, or to a certain matter
flashcards.example: I devoted this afternoon to repainting my study, and nothing will get in my way.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完全为了、致力于或致力于某件事而付出时间、集中精力、全身心投入等
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天下午我专门重新粉刷我的书房，没有什么会妨碍我的。

flashcards.definition: To execute fully; to fulfill; to complete successfully.
flashcards.example: to accomplish a design, an object, a promise
flashcards.definitionZh: 全面执行；履行；才能成功完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 完成一个设计、一个目标、一个承诺

flashcards.definition: Any of the genus Rumex of coarse weedy plants with small green flowers related to buckwheat, especially common dock, and used as potherbs and in folk medicine, especially in curing nettle rash.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dock.
flashcards.definitionZh: 酸模属的一种粗杂草植物，开有小绿花，与荞麦有关，特别是常见的酸模，用作野菜和民间药物，特别是用于治疗荨麻疹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是码头这个词。

flashcards.definition: Freight carried by a ship, aircraft, or motor vehicle.
flashcards.example: This is the word Cargo.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由船舶、飞机或机动车辆运输的货物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是货物这个词。

flashcards.definition: A motion of the limbs or body, especially one made to emphasize speech.
flashcards.example: The middle-finger gesture is really a nonverbal swear.
flashcards.definitionZh: 四肢或身体的运动，尤其是为了强调言语而进行的运动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 中指手势实际上是一种非语言的咒骂。

flashcards.definition: A lifting of the shoulders to signal indifference or a casual lack of knowledge.
flashcards.example: He dismissed my comment with a shrug.
flashcards.definitionZh: 举起肩膀表示冷漠或偶然缺乏知识。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他耸耸肩驳斥了我的评论。

flashcards.definition: To move (something) from one place to another.
flashcards.example: Air conveys sound. Water is conveyed through the pipe.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将（某物）从一个地方移动到另一个地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 空气传递声音。水通过管道输送。

flashcards.definition: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
flashcards.example: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当某物受力时所经历的弯曲量；在压力下有屈服的倾向；韧性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有屈服于教条式的宗教信仰。

flashcards.definition: A warden; a guard; a guardian or watchman.
flashcards.example: This is the word Ward.
flashcards.definitionZh: 典狱长；一名警卫；监护人或看守人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是沃德这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person presiding over a meeting.
flashcards.example: This is the word Chairman.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主持会议的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是主席这个词。

flashcards.definition: A female chairperson
flashcards.example: This is the word Chairwoman.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位女主席
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是主席一词。

flashcards.definition: A chairman or chairwoman, someone who presides over a meeting, board, etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word Chairperson.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主席或女主席、主持会议、董事会等​​的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是主席一词。

flashcards.definition: An item of furniture used to sit on or in, comprising a seat, legs, back, and sometimes arm rests, for use by one person. Compare stool, couch, sofa, settee, loveseat and bench.
flashcards.example: All I need to weather a snowstorm is hot coffee, a warm fire, a good book and a comfortable chair.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种用于坐在上面或里面的家具，包括座椅、腿、靠背，有时还有扶手，供一个人使用。比较凳子、沙发、沙发、长沙发、双人沙发和长凳。
flashcards.exampleZh: 抵御暴风雪所需的只是热咖啡、温暖的炉火、一本好书和一张舒适的椅子。

flashcards.definition: To be the setting or time of.
flashcards.example: 1999 saw the release of many great films.
flashcards.definitionZh: 是……的设定或时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1999 年上映了许多伟大的电影。

flashcards.definition: Any roughly cylindrical (or rectangular) unit of a substance.
flashcards.example: Sealing wax is available as a cylindrical or rectangular stick.
flashcards.definitionZh: 物质的任何大致圆柱形（或矩形）单元。
flashcards.exampleZh: 密封蜡有圆柱形或矩形棒状。

flashcards.definition: A temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to.
flashcards.example: This is the word Agenda.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对要处理的事项临时组织的计划。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是议程这个词。

flashcards.definition: An instance or example of using the word "but".
flashcards.example: It has to be done – no ifs or buts.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使用“但是”一词的实例或例子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 它必须完成——没有如果或但是。

flashcards.definition: The sound of a succession of chirps as uttered by birds.
flashcards.example: I often listen to the twitter of the birds in the park.
flashcards.definitionZh: 鸟儿发出的连续鸣叫声。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我经常在公园里聆听鸟儿的叽叽喳喳声。

flashcards.definition: Having a sensation of whirling, with a tendency to fall; giddy; feeling unbalanced or lightheaded.
flashcards.example: I stood up too fast and felt dizzy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有旋转的感觉，有坠落的倾向；头晕;感觉不平衡或头晕。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我站起来太快了，感到头晕。

flashcards.definition: A confused disordered jumble of things.
flashcards.example: This is the word Clutter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 杂乱无章的事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“混乱”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A party, celebration, social function.
flashcards.example: We’re having a bit of a do on Saturday to celebrate my birthday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚会、庆典、社交活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 周六我们会做一些事情来庆祝我的生日。

flashcards.definition: Miscellaneous items or objects; (with possessive) personal effects.
flashcards.example: What is all that stuff on your bedroom floor?  He didn't want his pockets to bulge so he was walking around with all his stuff in his hands.
flashcards.definitionZh: 杂项物品或物体； （具有所有格）个人物品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你卧室地板上的那些东西是什么？  他不想让自己的口袋鼓起来，所以他手里拿着所有的东西到处走。

flashcards.definition: Having an allergy.
flashcards.example: I am allergic to cats.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有过敏症。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对猫过敏。

flashcards.definition: A cylinder often of wood or metal used to fasten or as a bearing between two parts.
flashcards.example: Pull the pin out of the grenade before throwing it at the enemy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常由木材或金属制成的圆柱体，用于紧固或作为两个部件之间的轴承。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在将手榴弹扔向敌人之前，将其从手榴弹中拔出。

flashcards.definition: To substantiate or prove the truth of something
flashcards.example: This is the word Verify.
flashcards.definitionZh: 证实或证明某事的真实性
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“验证”一词。

flashcards.definition: To read quickly, skipping some detail
flashcards.example: I skimmed the newspaper over breakfast.
flashcards.definitionZh: 快速阅读，跳过一些细节
flashcards.exampleZh: 我一边吃早餐一边浏览报纸。

flashcards.definition: A regulation, law, guideline.
flashcards.example: All participants must adhere to the rules.
flashcards.definitionZh: 法规、法律、指南。
flashcards.exampleZh: 所有参与者都必须遵守规则。

flashcards.definition: A non-specific rule or principle that provides direction to action or behaviour.
flashcards.example: He considered the Ten Commandments more a guideline than a requirement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为行动或行为提供指导的非具体规则或原则。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他认为十诫更多的是一个指导方针，而不是一个要求。

flashcards.definition: A fall, especially end over end.
flashcards.example: I took a tumble down the stairs and broke my tooth.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跌倒，尤其是从头到尾的跌倒。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我从楼梯上摔下来，摔断了牙齿。

flashcards.definition: A tactic used to draw attention away from the real threat or action.
flashcards.example: This is the word Diversion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于转移人们对真正威胁或行动的注意力的策略。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“分流”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Something that impedes, stands in the way of, or holds up progress
flashcards.example: A big obstacle to understanding the manual was that it had been poorly translated from the Japanese.
flashcards.definitionZh: 阻碍、阻碍或阻碍进步的事物
flashcards.exampleZh: 理解该手册的一个很大障碍是它的日文翻译很差。

flashcards.definition: Belonging to, or performed by, the intellect; mental or cognitive.
flashcards.example: intellectual powers, activities, etc.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于智力，或由智力执行；心理或认知。
flashcards.exampleZh: 智力、活动等

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: Torn or worn; unkempt.
flashcards.example: They lived in a tiny apartment, with some old, shabby furniture.
flashcards.definitionZh: 撕裂或磨损；蓬头垢面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们住在一间小公寓里，里面有一些破旧的家具。

flashcards.definition: A part of a whole, especially a comparatively small part.
flashcards.example: This is the word Fraction.
flashcards.definitionZh: 整体的一部分，尤其是相对较小的部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是分数这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of seizing or capturing.
flashcards.example: The catch of the perpetrator was the product of a year of police work.
flashcards.definitionZh: 夺取或夺取的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 抓获肇事者是警方一年工作的成果。

flashcards.definition: Association football
flashcards.example: This is the word Soccer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 足球协会
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是足球这个词。

flashcards.definition: To confuse, disorientate, or puzzle someone, especially with many different choices.
flashcards.example: All the different possible options may bewilder us.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使某人感到困惑、迷失方向或困惑，尤其是在有许多不同的选择时。
flashcards.exampleZh: 所有不同的可能选择可能会让我们感到困惑。

flashcards.definition: To confuse the sight of by means of excessive brightness.
flashcards.example: Dazzled by the headlights of the lorry, the deer stopped in the middle of the street.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过过度的亮度来迷惑视线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 鹿被卡车的车头灯弄得眼花缭乱，停在了街中央。

flashcards.definition: The quality, colour, or appearance of the skin on the face.
flashcards.example: a rugged complexion;  a sunburnt complexion
flashcards.definitionZh: 面部皮肤的质量、颜色或外观。
flashcards.exampleZh: 肤色粗糙；  晒伤的肤色

flashcards.definition: To bring down the size, quantity, quality, value or intensity of something; to diminish, to lower.
flashcards.example: to reduce weight, speed, heat, expenses, price, personnel etc.
flashcards.definitionZh: 降低某物的大小、数量、质量、价值或强度；减少，降低。
flashcards.exampleZh: 减少重量、速度、热量、费用、价格、人员等。

flashcards.definition: (grammar) The prepositional case.
flashcards.example: This is the word Prepositional phrase.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）介词格。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是介词短语这个词。

flashcards.definition: To leave out or exclude.
flashcards.example: This is the word Omit.
flashcards.definitionZh: 遗漏或排除。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是省略这个词。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
flashcards.example: Waiter, please bring me a single malt whiskey.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）前往某人/某处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 服务员，请给我一杯单一麦芽威士忌。

flashcards.definition: Favoring fundamental change, or change at the root cause of a matter.
flashcards.example: His beliefs are radical.
flashcards.definitionZh: 赞成根本性改变，或改变问题的根本原因。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的信念是激进的。

flashcards.definition: An attempt.
flashcards.example: I gave unicycling a try but I couldn’t do it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次尝试。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我尝试过骑独轮车，但我做不到。

flashcards.definition: Skill, skilfulness, art, especially the skill needed for a particular profession .
flashcards.example: The craft of writing plays.
flashcards.definitionZh: 技能，技能，艺术，尤其是特定职业所需的技能。
flashcards.exampleZh: 写作技巧发挥着作用。

flashcards.definition: An act, instance of, or state of expansion or increase in size, especially by injection of a gas.
flashcards.example: The inflation of the balloon took five hours.
flashcards.definitionZh: 膨胀或尺寸增加的行为、实例或状态，尤其是通过注入气体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 气球充气花了五个小时。

flashcards.definition: To rise, especially rapidly or unusually high.
flashcards.example: The pump prices soared into new heights as the strike continued.
flashcards.definitionZh: 上升，特别迅速或异常高。
flashcards.exampleZh: 随着罢工的继续，汽油价格飙升至新高。

flashcards.definition: A beating, vibration or palpitation.
flashcards.example: This is the word Throb.
flashcards.definitionZh: 殴打、振动或心悸。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“颤动”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A normally regular beat felt when arteries are depressed, caused by the pumping action of the heart.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pulse.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当动脉受压时，由心脏的泵血作用引起，通常会感觉到有规律的搏动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是脉冲这个词。

flashcards.definition: A topic of discussion; a train of association, thoughts, emotions, etc.
flashcards.example: in the same vein
flashcards.definitionZh: 讨论的话题；一连串的联想、思想、情感等
flashcards.exampleZh: 同样地

flashcards.definition: To repeat, as what has been already said; to tell over again; to recite.
flashcards.example: There's no need to rehearse the same old argument; we've heard it before, and we all agree.
flashcards.definitionZh: 重复一遍，正如已经说过的那样；再说一遍；背诵。
flashcards.exampleZh: 没有必要重复同样的旧论点；我们以前听说过，而且都同意。

flashcards.definition: The practicing of something which is to be performed before an audience, usually to test or improve the interaction between several participating people, or to allow technical adjustments with respect to staging to be done.
flashcards.example: This is the word Rehearsal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在观众面前表演的练习，通常是为了测试或改善几个参与人员之间的互动，或者允许对舞台进行技术调整。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“排练”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
flashcards.example: I just got back from my morning run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跑步、用脚快速移动的动作或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我刚刚晨跑回来。

flashcards.definition: Extraverted: talkative, friendly, and social, especially with respect to meeting new people easily and comfortably.
flashcards.example: Tom is very outgoing and enjoys meeting people; his brother, on the other hand, is painfully shy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 外向：健谈、友好、善于社交，尤其是在轻松舒适地结识新朋友方面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 汤姆非常外向，喜欢结识朋友；另一方面，他的兄弟却非常害羞。

flashcards.definition: A mixture.
flashcards.example: This is the word Mingle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种混合物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“混合”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (when with and) Very, extremely. See good and.
flashcards.example: The soup is good and hot.
flashcards.definitionZh: (when with and) Very, extremely.见善与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 汤又好又热。

flashcards.definition: In a state of panic, worry, frenzy or rush.
flashcards.example: They returned the missing child to his frantic mother.
flashcards.definitionZh: 处于恐慌、担忧、疯狂或匆忙的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们把失踪的孩子还给了他疯狂的母亲。

flashcards.definition: A sight or view of the interior of anything; a deep inspection or view; introspection; frequently used with into.
flashcards.example: This is the word Insight.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何事物内部的景象或视图；深入检查或查看；内省;经常与 into 一起使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是洞察力这个词。

flashcards.definition: Perquisite.
flashcards.example: Free coffee is one of the perks of the job.
flashcards.definitionZh: 额外津贴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 免费咖啡是这份工作的福利之一。

flashcards.definition: An alkaloid, C8H10N4O2, found naturally in tea and coffee plants which acts as a mild stimulant on the central nervous system.
flashcards.example: This is the word Caffeine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种生物碱 C8H10N4O2，天然存在于茶和咖啡植物中，对中枢神经系统有温和的刺激作用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是咖啡因这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act, practice, or occupation of supervising and taking care of young children.
flashcards.example: This is the word Childcare.
flashcards.definitionZh: 监督和照顾幼儿的行为、做法或职业。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“儿童保育”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The prevention, treatment, and management of illness or the preservation of mental and physical well-being through the services offered by the medical, nursing, and allied health professions.
flashcards.example: I think free health care should also cover nearsightedness.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过医疗、护理和联合健康专业提供的服务来预防、治疗和管理疾病或保持身心健康。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我认为免费医疗保健也应该涵盖近视。

flashcards.definition: Deep-seated and/or long-term animosity or ill will about something or someone, especially due to a past misdeed or mistreatment.
flashcards.example: to have/hold/bear a grudge against someone
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某事或某人的根深蒂固和/或长期的敌意或恶意，尤其是由于过去的不当行为或虐待。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对某人怀恨在心

flashcards.definition: A mark made by smearing.
flashcards.example: This detergent cleans windows without leaving smears.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过涂抹而做出的标记。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这种清洁剂可以清洁窗户而不留下污迹。

flashcards.definition: A person who, although present at some event, does not take part in it; an observer or spectator.
flashcards.example: This is the word Bystander.
flashcards.definitionZh: 尽管出席某些活动但并未参加的人；观察者或旁观者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是旁观者这个词。

flashcards.definition: Something which causes someone to want to commit a crime; a reason for criminal behaviour.
flashcards.example: No-one could understand why she had hidden the shovel; her motives were obscure at best.
flashcards.definitionZh: 导致某人想要犯罪的事情；犯罪行为的原因。
flashcards.exampleZh: 没有人能理解她为什么要把铲子藏起来。她的动机充其量是模糊的。

flashcards.definition: To resist or endure (something) successfully.
flashcards.example: This is the word Withstand.
flashcards.definitionZh: 成功地抵抗或忍受（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“顶住”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.
flashcards.example: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较远的地方移动到较近的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她来时，她会绕山而来[...]

flashcards.definition: A loss of greatness or status.
flashcards.example: the fall of Rome
flashcards.definitionZh: 失去伟大或地位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗马的陷落

flashcards.definition: Thorough, careful, or vigilant in one’s task performance.
flashcards.example: He was a thoughtful and conscientious worker.
flashcards.definitionZh: 执行任务时彻底、小心或保持警惕。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是一位有思想、尽职尽责的工人。

flashcards.definition: A company, business, organization, or other purposeful endeavor.
flashcards.example: A micro-enterprise is defined as a business having 5 or fewer employees and a low seed capital.
flashcards.definitionZh: 公司、企业、组织或其他有目的的活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 微型企业被定义为拥有 5 名或更少员工且原始资本较低的企业。

flashcards.definition: A field of economic activity
flashcards.example: public sector;  private sector
flashcards.definitionZh: 经济活动领域
flashcards.exampleZh: 公共部门；  私营部门

flashcards.definition: To burn with no flame and little smoke.
flashcards.example: This is the word Smoulder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 燃烧时无火焰且几乎没有烟雾。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是闷烧这个词。

flashcards.definition: To extinguish or deaden, as fire, by covering, overlaying, or otherwise excluding the air.
flashcards.example: to smother a fire with ashes
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过覆盖、覆盖或以其他方式排除空气来熄灭或熄灭，如火。
flashcards.exampleZh: 用灰烬扑灭大火

flashcards.definition: To destroy or abolish something
flashcards.example: She extinguished all my hopes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 摧毁或废除某物
flashcards.exampleZh: 她浇灭了我所有的希望。

flashcards.definition: To cause to feel extreme apprehension or unease; to cause to experience horror.
flashcards.example: The haunted house was horrifying, from one room to the next I felt more and more like I wasn’t going to survive.

flashcards.example: They got caught in a downpour without an umbrella and came back soaked.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场大雨。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们遭遇倾盆大雨，没有带伞，回来时浑身湿透。

flashcards.definition: Immediately, at once; quickly.
flashcards.example: This is the word Presently  soon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 立刻，马上；迅速地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“现在很快”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To deliver into the hands of an enemy by treachery or fraud, in violation of trust; to give up treacherously or faithlessly.
flashcards.example: an officer betrayed the city
flashcards.definitionZh: 违反信任，通过背叛或欺诈将货物交付敌人手中；背信弃义或不忠实地放弃。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一名军官背叛了这座城市

flashcards.definition: To kill as punishment for capital crimes.
flashcards.example: There are certain states where it is lawful to execute prisoners convicted of certain crimes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以杀人作为对死刑罪行的惩罚。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在某些州，处决犯有某些罪行的囚犯是合法的。

flashcards.definition: A squat, swaying gait.
flashcards.example: the waddle of a duck
flashcards.definitionZh: 蹲着、摇摆的步态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 鸭子摇摇摆摆

flashcards.definition: Any of several flightless sea birds, of order Sphenisciformes, found in the Southern Hemisphere, marked by their usual upright stance, walking on short legs, and (generally) their stark black and white plumage.
flashcards.example: This is the word Penguin.
flashcards.definitionZh: 南半球发现的几种不会飞的海鸟，属于楔形目，其特点是通常直立站立，用短腿行走，并且（通常）有鲜明的黑白羽毛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是企鹅这个词。

flashcards.definition: Absolute, unconditional, total, complete.
flashcards.example: utter ruin; utter darkness
flashcards.definitionZh: 绝对的、无条件的、全部的、完整的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 彻底毁灭；完全黑暗

flashcards.definition: The state or act of contemning; the feeling or attitude of regarding someone or something as inferior, base, or worthless; scorn, disdain.
flashcards.example: This is the word Contempt.
flashcards.definitionZh: 蔑视的状态或行为；认为某人或某物低等、卑鄙或无价值的感觉或态度；蔑视，蔑视。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是蔑视这个词。

flashcards.definition: A small long and narrow boat, propelled by one or more people (depending on the size of canoe), using single-bladed paddles. The paddlers face in the direction of travel, in either a seated position, or kneeling on the bottom of the boat. Canoes are open on top, and pointed at both ends.
flashcards.example: This is the word Canoe.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种狭长的小船，由一个或多个人（取决于独木舟的大小）使用单叶桨推动。桨手面朝行进方向，要么坐着，要么跪在船底。独木舟顶部开口，两端尖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是独木舟这个词。

flashcards.definition: Time spent on paddling.
flashcards.example: We had a nice paddle this morning.
flashcards.definitionZh: 时间花在划桨上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天早上我们划了一个很好的桨。

flashcards.definition: A medical injection.
flashcards.example: Our dog was exposed to rabies, so the whole family went to a clinic to get our jabs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 医疗注射。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的狗感染了狂犬病，所以全家人都去诊所注射疫苗。

flashcards.definition: The action of dangling; a series of complex stick tricks and fakes in order to defeat the defender in style.
flashcards.example: That was a sick dangle for a great goal!
flashcards.definitionZh: 悬空的动作；一系列复杂的棍术和假动作，以优雅地击败防守者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对于一个伟大的进球来说，这真是一个病态的悬念！

flashcards.definition: To push, throw over, overturn or overthrow something
flashcards.example: The massed crowds toppled the statue of the former dictator.
flashcards.definitionZh: 推、扔、推翻或推翻某物
flashcards.exampleZh: 聚集的人群推倒了前独裁者的雕像。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word thats all right.
flashcards.example: This is the word thats all right.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没关系这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 就是这个词，没关系。

flashcards.definition: To express (an action, thought or idea) by means of particular words.
flashcards.example: I wasn't sure how to phrase my condolences without sounding patronising.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过特定的词语来表达（行动、思想或想法）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不知道如何表达我的哀悼而又不显得居高临下。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word word-building exercise.
flashcards.example: This is the word word-building exercise.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单词构建练习的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是单词构词练习。

flashcards.definition: A watchword or rallying cry, a verbal signal (even when consisting of multiple words).
flashcards.example: mum's the word
flashcards.definitionZh: 口号或战斗口号，口头信号（即使由多个单词组成）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 妈妈的话

flashcards.definition: The style of writing of a person.
flashcards.example: I can't read your writing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的写作风格。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我读不懂你的文字。
